elements.body:
Engineering assumptions for a restricted, attached-flow sizing case.
These are not measured confidence bounds or a demonstrated stall boundary.
Published crescent-wing tests establish method relevance, but their section,
Reynolds number and setup do not validate this CAD geometry.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Engineering assumptions for a restricted, attached-flow sizing case.
         * These are not measured confidence bounds or a demonstrated stall boundary.
         * Published crescent-wing tests establish method relevance, but their section,
         * Reynolds number and setup do not validate this CAD geometry. */

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Use the former adverse aerodynamic case for primary sizing. Restrict nominal incidence and heel to reduce reliance on separated flow and large spanwise inflow. The observed heel sensitivity motivates additional conservatism, not a universal calibrated correction. Moment uncertainty is independent of reduced lift credit so lower propulsion credit does not automatically reduce predicted actuator demand. All geometry variables remain free within their existing model brackets."; }

metadata issue : ModelingMetadata::Issue { text = "Matched low-Re forward/reverse section measurements, measured pitching moments, finite-thickness effects, and heel-dependent full-grid validation remain missing. The retained cosine projection and uncertainty factors are provisional. A feasible solve establishes only feasibility under these assumptions."; }

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "An additional uncalibrated adverse hypothesis, not a probability distribution or a validated worst case. Re-solve controls at the selected geometry to expose remaining sensitivity."; }

elements.body: Qualitative, conditional avoidance failure analysis. All review actions remain open. Tree propositions are defined over one encounter response interval. elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Authoritative accounting for the retained 440 Wh candidate's archived
     * nominal finite-passage screen. Inputs are projected from its source revision
     * and immutable replay; this is not an installed equipment qualification.
     * No independent electronics component split or perception capability is credited. */
attribute :>> basis = "Lumped allocation; hardware, duty and surge unmeasured";
attribute :>> label = "Wired wind sensor and interface";
attribute :>> basis = "Supplier sensor demand plus interface, conversion and margin allowances; startup unmeasured";
attribute :>> basis = "Native torque/duty model: 2 percent moving, 98 percent holding; no motor holding current";
attribute :>> basis = "Native torque/duty model: 5 percent moving, 95 percent holding";
attribute :>> basis = "Maximum sampled average throughout exposure; peak uses the maximum-total-peak operating case";
part def Account { attribute label : String; attribute energyWh : Real; attribute basis : String; }
part nominal : Account { attribute :>> label = "Nameplate battery"; attribute :>> energyWh = candidate.batteryWh; attribute :>> basis = "Allocated capacity, not measured capacity"; }
part usable : Account { attribute :>> label = "Usable capacity"; attribute :>> energyWh = candidate.batteryWh*energyInputs.usableFraction; attribute :>> basis = "80 percent of nameplate"; }

part departure : Account { attribute :>> label = "Departure stored energy"; attribute :>> energyWh = usable.energyWh*energyInputs.initialFraction; attribute :>> basis = "90 percent of usable capacity"; }

part sailing : Account { attribute :>> label = "Energy delivered to sailing loads"; attribute :>> energyWh = totals.busWh; attribute :>> basis = "Average bus power times the full passage allowance"; }
part losses : Account { attribute :>> label = "Discharge losses"; attribute :>> energyWh = totals.batteryWh-totals.busWh; attribute :>> basis = "90 percent discharge efficiency; applied once"; }
part selfDischarge : Account { attribute :>> label = "Self-discharge"; attribute :>> energyWh = exposureHours*energyInputs.selfDischargeW; attribute :>> basis = "0.02 W battery-side withdrawal"; }

part reserve : Account { attribute :>> label = "Protected recovery reserve"; attribute :>> energyWh = energyInputs.reserveWh; attribute :>> basis = "Synthetic allocation: 50 W motor for 0.5 h plus 8 W essentials for 2 h, times 1.2"; }

part required : Account { attribute :>> label = "Total required at departure"; attribute :>> energyWh = totals.batteryWh+selfDischarge.energyWh+reserve.energyWh; attribute :>> basis = "Sailing withdrawal, self-discharge and reserve; zero harvest credit"; }

part headroom : Account { attribute :>> label = "Remaining headroom"; attribute :>> energyWh = departure.energyWh-required.energyWh; attribute :>> basis = "Unallocated margin after the protected recovery reserve"; }
part def Gap { attribute function : String; attribute allowance : String; attribute evidenceNeeded : String; }

part compute : Gap { attribute :>> function = "Mission computer and avoidance inference"; attribute :>> allowance = "Within 4.5 W lump; no separately established allocation"; attribute :>> evidenceNeeded = "Selected pipeline, measured sustained/peak power, latency and thermal performance"; }

part navigation : Gap { attribute :>> function = "GNSS and attitude sensing"; attribute :>> allowance = "Within 4.5 W lump; no separately established allocation"; attribute :>> evidenceNeeded = "Installed equipment and bus measurements"; }

part traffic : Gap { attribute :>> function = "AIS, cameras, radar, hydrophones and sonar"; attribute :>> allowance = "Unselected; no incremental load or detection capability established"; attribute :>> evidenceNeeded = "Sensing trade and installed acquisition/processing power"; }

part communications : Gap { attribute :>> function = "Telemetry, command link and recording"; attribute :>> allowance = "Within 4.5 W lump; no separately established allocation"; attribute :>> evidenceNeeded = "Transmit/receive duty, peaks and logging demand"; }

part housekeeping : Gap { attribute :>> function = "Signals, recovery control, ingress sensing and power management"; attribute :>> allowance = "Within 4.5 W lump; no separately established allocation"; attribute :>> evidenceNeeded = "Operating modes, quiescent demand and fault independence"; }

part recoveryHardware : Gap { attribute :>> function = "Recovery propulsion"; attribute :>> allowance = "Energy reserve allocated separately; no installed propulsion power rating established"; attribute :>> evidenceNeeded = "Measured thrust/power, casualty reachability and electrical peak capability"; }

elements.body: Current owner-approved class-specific detection and consequence approach, 2026-10-16. No blanket 750 m floor applies to current policy. Earlier six-class and IC-01 acquisition numbers remain historical hypotheses in their original analyses. No numerical consequence, reliability or risk acceptance thresholds were selected by this policy change.

Detection distance must cover relative motion during observation/decision/maneuver delay, position uncertainty and reviewed clearance/margin. Consequences and exposure separately inform clearance and required reliability; do not multiply kinematic distance by severity or call a whole class harmless. Collision and nonimpediment obligations remain. No current class allocation is accepted without applicable review and evidence.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Detection distance must cover relative motion during observation/decision/maneuver delay, position uncertainty and reviewed clearance/margin. Consequences and exposure separately inform clearance and required reliability; do not multiply kinematic distance by severity or call a whole class harmless. Collision and nonimpediment obligations remain. No current class allocation is accepted without applicable review and evidence.*/

attribute consequenceReview : String = "Review actual vessel mass and relative contact speed, contact geometry, rigid appendages, entanglement, capsize/immersion, occupant vulnerability and secondary collision/impediment. A low-speed glancing hull contact may have low direct damage under supported conditions; that is not a whole-class near-zero consequence allocation.";

attribute classificationRule : String = "Before reliable classification, use a reviewed conservative envelope spanning plausible classes and occupant transitions. An apparently empty craft may have a person beside it; unknown is not unoccupied. Classification range must support the transition to a narrower envelope. With no reviewed conservative envelope, admission remains unsupported.";

attribute reliabilityMeaning : String = "Required probability concerns timely acquisition AND sufficient track continuity for the admitted encounter class/conditions, not per-frame detector accuracy. Review exposure, false negatives, false positives and confidence basis. A lower confidence bound must come from applicable independent evidence; supplied booleans alone cannot establish acceptance.";
attribute currentStatus : String = "Open: class clearances, consequence margins, required reliability/confidence and risk dispositions await review and evidence.";

elements.body: Historical sensitivity inputs only: ownship 3 m/s; first five classes inherit earlier target speeds/separations. The four newly separated slow classes each reuse the former broad low-target 2 m/s and 20 m solely to show comparison arithmetic; they are not measured speeds or selected class clearances. Equal illustrated distances do not imply equal consequence or required reliability. No sensing simulation is changed.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Historical sensitivity inputs only: ownship 3 m/s; first five classes inherit earlier target speeds/separations. The four newly separated slow classes each reuse the former broad low-target 2 m/s and 20 m solely to show comparison arithmetic; they are not measured speeds or selected class clearances. Equal illustrated distances do not imply equal consequence or required reliability. No sensing simulation is changed.*/

elements.body: Current class allocation/evidence gate. Required real inputs have no zero defaults. Kinematic and reviewed-design distances are not accepted deployment envelopes. Acquisition-and-track probability is separate from the whole detection-decision-maneuver response probability; no independence multiplication is assumed. Both lower confidence bounds must meet the reviewed confidence level. Method review must address sampling, correlation, uncertainty and applicability; sample count alone proves nothing. References name applicable reviewed records, not merely nonempty labels. Class-specific credit requires reliable classification; unclassified requires a reviewed conservative plausible-class envelope. allocationAccepted means supplied evidence passes this declared analysis gate, not physical qualification or full navigation-law compliance.

Consistency gate on supplied reviewed bounds and evidence declarations only. Nonempty references are declarations: this analysis does not read or validate their contents, applicability or approval. Passing is not certification or physical qualification.

elements.body:
Technical risk assessment for the next concept-selection and integrated-test
planning spiral. Qualitative likelihood rates the prospect that an identified
limitation forces redesign or operating-envelope restriction. Consequence rates
the credible effect if it is not addressed. These are ordinal engineering
judgments, not incident probabilities, expected losses or residual-risk acceptance.
Standard technicalRisk probability and impact remain unset without quantitative evidence.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Technical risk assessment for the next concept-selection and integrated-test
     * planning spiral. Qualitative likelihood rates the prospect that an identified
     * limitation forces redesign or operating-envelope restriction. Consequence rates
     * the credible effect if it is not addressed. These are ordinal engineering
     * judgments, not incident probabilities, expected losses or residual-risk acceptance.
     * Standard technicalRisk probability and impact remain unset without quantitative evidence.
     */
attribute assessor : String default "Analysis agent; owner review pending";

attribute assessmentScope : String default "Next concept-selection and integrated-test planning spiral; likelihood of redesign or operating-envelope restriction, not a probability of an accident on a voyage.";
attribute residualDisposition : String default "Open; no residual-risk acceptance recorded";
metadata workStatus : ModelingMetadata::StatusInfo { status = ModelingMetadata::StatusKind::open; owner = "Analysis agent; owner reviews disposition"; }

assessmentBasis = "Current class-specific detection allocations require reviewed kinematics, consequence-informed clearance, observation and whole-response reliability, confidence and risk disposition. Those inputs and installed evidence remain open. Historical IC-01 synthetic closure used a uniform 750 m sensing hypothesis; it does not establish the new class policy or measured installation. A missed encounter can compromise other river users.";
residualDisposition = "Open; Mitigate; require sensing and maneuver evidence before admitting the affected operating envelope. No residual-risk acceptance recorded.";
statement = "If installed sensing cannot acquire and track relevant traffic early enough, the vessel cannot safely execute the allocated avoidance maneuver.";

elements.body:
busyAtDeliveryS is residual occupancy WHEN the usable observation
reaches guidance, not at envelope entry. Acquisition and delivery must
be disjoint measured intervals. Phase is the next eligible assessment
opportunity after both observation availability and controller release.
The old one-second assessment allocation is counted here ONCE; there
is no additional one-second processing term. New command and avoidance
duration are separate from the remaining OLD command/maneuver.

elements.body:
busyAtEntryS is time until release measured at envelope entry.
Observation production overlaps that ONE known occupied interval.
This branch assumes no new unrelated maneuver starts before observation
delivery; use a residual-at-delivery bound otherwise. Phase is charged
once, after the later of observation delivery and controller release.

doc /* busyAtEntryS is time until release measured at envelope entry.
         * Observation production overlaps that ONE known occupied interval.
         * This branch assumes no new unrelated maneuver starts before observation
         * delivery; use a residual-at-delivery bound otherwise. Phase is charged
         * once, after the later of observation delivery and controller release. */

return seconds : Real = (if readyS > busyAtEntryS ? readyS else busyAtEntryS)
            +assessmentPhaseS+commandS+avoidanceS+contingencyS;

elements.body: Caller supplies supported bounds, not nominal turn time. Set motionBoundAvailable=false for stalled or unresolved maneuver authority and observationBoundAvailable=false for presence-only/unbounded tracks. Unsupported distances are -1. occupiedAtDelivery selects the epoch of occupiedS. This scalar necessary timing screen does not prove safe motion or rules compliance. appliesTrafficRequirement selects the historical six-class comparison scope, excluding weeds. Its retained 750 m floor is historical only; current BlueDogClassDetection policy has no such floor.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Caller supplies supported bounds, not nominal turn time. Set motionBoundAvailable=false for stalled or unresolved maneuver authority and observationBoundAvailable=false for presence-only/unbounded tracks. Unsupported distances are -1. occupiedAtDelivery selects the epoch of occupiedS. This scalar necessary timing screen does not prove safe motion or rules compliance. appliesTrafficRequirement selects the historical six-class comparison scope, excluding weeds. Its retained 750 m floor is historical only; current BlueDogClassDetection policy has no such floor.*/

out attribute supported : Boolean = motionBoundAvailable and observationBoundAvailable
            and acquisitionS >= 0 and deliveryS >= 0 and occupiedS >= 0
            and assessmentPhaseS >= 0 and commandS >= 0 and avoidanceS >= 0
            and contingencyS >= 0 and separationM >= 0 and positionAllowanceM >= 0;
out attribute requiredRangeM : Real = if supported ? RangeForResponse(relativeSpeedMps,responseSeconds,separationM,positionAllowanceM) else -1;
out attribute fitsRetainedDistance : Boolean = appliesTrafficRequirement and supported and requiredRangeM <= retainedRequirementM;

out attribute combinedEnvelopeM : Real = if not supported ? -1 else if not appliesTrafficRequirement ? requiredRangeM else if requiredRangeM > retainedRequirementM ? requiredRangeM else retainedRequirementM;

out attribute status : String = if not supported ? "Unsupported: no finite response-distance claim" else if not appliesTrafficRequirement ? "Scenario timing sensitivity only; historical 750 m traffic comparison not applicable" else if fitsRetainedDistance ? "Within historical 750 m timing budget only; no current acceptance" else "Exceeds historical 750 m comparison; current class allocation remains open";

metadata issue : ModelingMetadata::Issue { text = "Qualification shall use coupled wind, current and waves plus separate wake events. The SRR allocations define the design domain; measured route profiles and forecast-conditioned exposure are required before field release. Do not infer joint extremes by combining independent maxima or assign return periods without evidence."; }

attribute recoveryExposureBasis : String = "Course-dependent transit and final retrieval exposure, including forecast deterioration; exposure ends at retained, retrievable shore arrival plus the declared pickup delay. No fixed challenge or survival deadline is imposed.";

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Propose 1.5 m significant wave height and 1.5-5 s peak period for review: the native 6-15 m/s wind, 3-15 km fetch sensitivity yields approximately 0.21-1.22 m and 1.80-4.28 s before current and wakes. The rounding margin is an engineering allocation, not a measured extreme. Retain 15 m/s mean wind, 20 m/s gust and 1.5 m/s current as unaccepted study allocations. Calm waiting is an allowed mission state, not a minimum-wind failure. Dense fog matters through loss of safety capability."; }

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Design stress allocations, not climate return levels. Apply for the longest modeled casualty transit under the forecast-conditioned current field plus 2 h arranged pickup delay. Require launch logistics capable of this pickup delay; otherwise use the longer declared delay and re-evaluate flotation, retention and energy. Operational waves use Hs <= 1.5 m, Tp 1.5-5 s and an explicit 3 m individual-wave case. Recovery uses Hs <= 2 m, Tp 1.5-7 s and a 4 m individual-wave case. No independent-maxima probability is claimed. Ice, dam transit and surf-zone launch remain outside scope."; }

elements.body:
Inverse performance demand and a wave-speed reference, not a VPP.
The route is aligned with the wind axis; symmetric tacks/gybes cancel
cross-track motion, with no cross-current. TWA uses water-relative true
wind. Leeway increases the absolute track angle away from the wind.
A uniform maneuver factor reduces average water VMG; current continues
throughout. Environmental retention is a through-water speed factor here.
Weather holds are separate in VoyageProfile.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Inverse performance demand and a wave-speed reference, not a VPP.
     * The route is aligned with the wind axis; symmetric tacks/gybes cancel
     * cross-track motion, with no cross-current. TWA uses water-relative true
     * wind. Leeway increases the absolute track angle away from the wind.
     * A uniform maneuver factor reduces average water VMG; current continues
     * throughout. Environmental retention is a through-water speed factor here.
     * Weather holds are separate in VoyageProfile.
     */

if retention > 0 and retention <= 1 and maneuver > 0 and maneuver <= 1 and projection > 0 and projection <= 1 ?
            (if groundTarget > current ? (groundTarget - current) / (retention * maneuver * projection) else 0 [m/s])
        else 0 [m/s]
attribute projection : Real = CourseProjection(trueWindAngle, leeway, windward);

attribute demandInputsValid : Boolean = distance > 0 [m] and trueWindSpeed > 0 [m/s] and
            trueWindAngle >= 0 [rad] and trueWindAngle <= TrigFunctions::pi * (1 [rad]) and
            leeway >= 0 [rad] and trueWindAngle + leeway <= TrigFunctions::pi * (1 [rad]) and
            projection > 0.000001 and projection <= 1 and retainedPerformance > 0 and retainedPerformance <= 1 and
            maneuverRetention > 0 and maneuverRetention <= 1 and waterlineLength > 0 [m] and allocatedTime > 0 [s] and
            minimumGroundVMG >= 0 [m/s];
attribute timeTarget : SpeedValue = if allocatedTime > 0 [s] ? distance / allocatedTime else 0 [m/s];
attribute requiredGroundVMG : SpeedValue = if timeTarget > minimumGroundVMG ? timeTarget else minimumGroundVMG;
attribute requiredCleanPolar : SpeedValue = RequiredPolarSpeed(requiredGroundVMG, currentVMG, retainedPerformance, maneuverRetention, projection);
out attribute inputsValid : Boolean = leg.demandInputsValid and leg.cleanPolarSpeed > 0 [m/s];
out attribute requiredOperatingSpeed : SpeedValue = requiredCleanPolarSpeed * leg.retainedPerformance;
out attribute requiredSpeedWindRatio : Real = if inputsValid ? requiredCleanPolarSpeed / leg.trueWindSpeed else 0;
out attribute allocatedDurationMet : Boolean = leg.valid and BlueDogRequirements::PassageDurationCriterion(leg.travelTime, leg.allocatedTime);
out attribute requiredCleanFroude : Real = LengthFroude(requiredCleanPolarSpeed, leg.waterlineLength);
out attribute requiredOperatingFroude : Real = LengthFroude(requiredOperatingSpeed, leg.waterlineLength);
out attribute exceedsWaveReference : Boolean = requiredCleanPolarSpeed > waveReference;
out attribute evidenceReady : Boolean = leg.polarEvidenceAccepted and leg.hullEvidenceAccepted;
return modeledFeasible : Boolean = inputsValid and leg.valid and allocatedDurationMet;
out attribute performanceSupported : Boolean = modeledFeasible and evidenceReady;
attribute :>> profileEvidenceAccepted = legs->ControlFunctions::forAll { in leg : PolarLeg; leg.polarEvidenceAccepted and leg.hullEvidenceAccepted };

out attribute legBudgetsMet : Boolean = profile.legs->ControlFunctions::forAll { in leg : PolarLeg;
            leg.valid and BlueDogRequirements::PassageDurationCriterion(leg.travelTime, leg.allocatedTime) };
out attribute groundSpeeds : SpeedValue [*] ordered nonunique = cruise.groundSpeeds;
return modeledFeasible : Boolean = allocationValid and legBudgetsMet and cruise.modeledFeasible;
out attribute voyageSupported : Boolean = modeledFeasible and cruise.reliabilitySupported;
assert constraint validInputs { leg.demandInputsValid and leg.leeway == 0 [rad] }
out attribute beatAngles : Real [*] ordered = (6..15)->ControlFunctions::collect { in i : Integer; i * 5.0 };
out attribute runAngles : Real [*] ordered = (21..36)->ControlFunctions::collect { in i : Integer; i * 5.0 };

out attribute beatSpeeds : SpeedValue [*] ordered nonunique = beatAngles->ControlFunctions::collect { in a : Real;
            RequiredPolarSpeed(leg.requiredGroundVMG, leg.currentVMG, leg.retainedPerformance, leg.maneuverRetention, CourseProjection(TrigFunctions::rad(a) * (1 [rad]), leg.leeway, true)) };

out attribute runSpeeds : SpeedValue [*] ordered nonunique = runAngles->ControlFunctions::collect { in a : Real;
            RequiredPolarSpeed(leg.requiredGroundVMG, leg.currentVMG, leg.retainedPerformance, leg.maneuverRetention, CourseProjection(TrigFunctions::rad(a) * (1 [rad]), leg.leeway, false)) };
out attribute waterlines : LengthValue [*] ordered = (2..16)->ControlFunctions::collect { in i : Integer; i * 0.25 [m] };
out attribute waveSpeeds : SpeedValue [*] ordered = waterlines->ControlFunctions::collect { in length : LengthValue; WaveReferenceSpeed(length) };
out attribute operatingDemand : SpeedValue = leg.requiredCleanPolar * leg.retainedPerformance;
return computed : Boolean = leg.demandInputsValid and leg.leeway == 0 [rad];

elements.body:
The judgments below are engineering hypotheses to verify on the installed boat. No numerical score or weighting is assigned without measured performance and an agreed priority.

| Criterion / requirement | Submerged water propeller | Above-water air propeller | Evidence needed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Thrust versus energy, R-001/R-002 | Dense working fluid favors compact low-speed thrust; actual losses depend on diameter, pitch, immersion and installation | Lower density drives greater disk area or induced velocity for comparable static thrust; battery demand may dominate | Hull tow test, installed thrust/power curves and recovery run |
| Milfoil, N-053–N-056 | Blades, shaft and guard can wrap or collect stems; a duct/guard is not automatically weed-proof | Rotor avoids submerged stems while upright, but hull/keel/rudder can still anchor the boat in vegetation | Same patch and snag tests, including restart after blockage |
| Sailing drag and packaging | Submerged installation adds drag; folding/retracting concepts introduce moving parts and new failure modes | Adds windage, deck volume, possible sail interference and elevated mass | Coast/tow drag, wind-load and sail-clearance measurements |
| Capsize and waves, N-051/N-052 | Can ventilate or leave water while heeled; immersed motor/shaft sealing is central | Rotor can strike water, guard or rig during heel/capsize; restart while wet must be qualified | Heel clearances, disabled-rotor immersion, self-righting and post-capsize restart |
| Steering and reverse | Rudder-in-slipstream or steerable pod possible; reverse depends on selected propeller/drive | Air rudder, vectored thrust or differential thrust may be needed at low boat speed; ordinary air propellers are not assumed efficient in reverse | Low-speed turning, stopping and control-loss tests |
| Guarding and handling, S-003 | Contact hazard at launch/recovery; guards can collect weeds and add drag | Accessible high-speed rotor needs physical separation/guarding; larger guard increases windage and mass | Isolation timing, access assessment, guard deflection/clearance under loads |
| Corrosion and maintenance, N-042/P-003 | Continuous immersion, seals/bearings and dissimilar metals need attention | Less continuous immersion but still salt spray, condensation and capsize exposure | Exposure campaign and timed replacement |
| Wind sensitivity | Hull wind load still affects recovery; underwater inflow follows boat/current | Propeller inflow also changes directly with apparent wind and yaw | Installed testing across recovery wind headings |
| Cost and manufacturability | Waterproof drive hardware may add complexity; custom printed rotating blades are not assumed qualified | Hobby components may simplify prototyping, but marine protection and guards remain additional work | Actual BOM, mass, print jobs and supplier operating limits |

candidate.diskDiameter > 0 [m] and candidate.density > 0 [kg/m^3] and
            candidate.axialInflow >= 0 [m/s] and candidate.requiredThrust >= 0 [N] and
            candidate.overallEfficiency > 0 and candidate.overallEfficiency <= 1 and

elements.body:
Conditional constant-hazard exposure model, not a sailing simulator.
Water VMG already includes heading/tacking; current is signed along route.
Rates must be mission-critical, non-overlapping and confidence-qualified.
No repair, independence of random modes and constant hazard are assumptions.
Common-cause exposure is explicit. DFMEA rankings are not failure rates.
Each profile is conditional on its declared weather trajectory. Integrate
route success and survival over trajectories, not hazard at mean successful
duration. BlueDogWeather::policy separates challenge and winter exposure.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Conditional constant-hazard exposure model, not a sailing simulator.
     * Water VMG already includes heading/tacking; current is signed along route.
     * Rates must be mission-critical, non-overlapping and confidence-qualified.
     * No repair, independence of random modes and constant hazard are assumptions.
     * Common-cause exposure is explicit. DFMEA rankings are not failure rates.
     * Each profile is conditional on its declared weather trajectory. Integrate
     * route success and survival over trajectories, not hazard at mean successful
     * duration. BlueDogWeather::policy separates challenge and winter exposure.
     */
attribute groundVMG : SpeedValue = waterVMG * retainedPerformance + currentVMG;

attribute valid : Boolean = distance > 0 [m] and waterVMG > 0 [m/s] and
            retainedPerformance > 0 and retainedPerformance <= 1 and groundVMG > 0 [m/s];
attribute travelTime : TimeValue = if valid ? distance / groundVMG else 0 [s];

elements.body:
Review assertions, not measured rates or proof of independence.
Establish non-overlapping critical-function loss terms, dependence treatment
and common-cause coverage for this configuration/profile before crediting
the study evidence. A primary component fault need not be function loss.
NIST Handbook 8.1.8 and defense R&M BoK 2025 section 3.2.4 inform this basis.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
comment rateBasis /* Review assertions, not measured rates or proof of independence.
         * Establish non-overlapping critical-function loss terms, dependence treatment
         * and common-cause coverage for this configuration/profile before crediting
         * the study evidence. A primary component fault need not be function loss.
         * NIST Handbook 8.1.8 and defense R&M BoK 2025 section 3.2.4 inform this basis. */

attribute valid : Boolean = SequenceFunctions::size(legs) > 0 and
            legs->ControlFunctions::forAll { in leg : SailingLeg; leg.valid } and
            holdTime >= 0 [s] and qualifiedDuration > 0 [s] and
            SequenceFunctions::size(criticalRatesPerHour) > 0 and
            criticalRatesPerHour->ControlFunctions::forAll { in rate : Real; rate >= 0 } and
            commonCauseRatePerHour >= 0 and zeroFailureTestHours > 0 and observedCriticalFailures >= 0;
out attribute groundSpeeds : SpeedValue [*] ordered nonunique = profile.legs.groundVMG;
out attribute allowableRatePerHour : Real = if inputsValid ? MarineReliability::EqualSurvivalRate(0.90, voyageHours) else 0;
out attribute modeledReliability : Real = if inputsValid ? MarineReliability::ConstantHazardSurvival(profile.totalRatePerHour, voyageHours) else 0;
out attribute rateBudgetMet : Boolean = inputsValid and BlueDogRequirements::FailureRateCriterion(profile.totalRatePerHour, voyageHours);
out attribute requiredZeroFailureHours : Real = if inputsValid ? -OpenSysMLMathFunctions::ln(0.05) / allowableRatePerHour else 0;
out attribute demonstrationApplicable : Boolean = inputsValid and profile.observedCriticalFailures == 0;
out attribute zeroFailureUpperRate : Real = if demonstrationApplicable ? -OpenSysMLMathFunctions::ln(0.05) / profile.zeroFailureTestHours else 0;
out attribute demonstratedReliabilityLowerBound : Real = if demonstrationApplicable ? OpenSysMLMathFunctions::exp(-zeroFailureUpperRate * voyageHours) else 0;
out attribute demonstrationMet : Boolean = demonstrationApplicable and BlueDogRequirements::MissionReliabilityCriterion(demonstratedReliabilityLowerBound, 0.95);

out attribute evidenceReady : Boolean = profile.profileEvidenceAccepted and profile.rateEvidenceAccepted and profile.constantHazardAccepted
            and profile.criticalFunctionPartitionAccepted and profile.dependenceTreatmentAccepted and profile.commonCauseCoverageAccepted;

return modeledFeasible : Boolean = inputsValid and durationMet;
out attribute reliabilitySupported : Boolean = modeledFeasible and rateBudgetMet and demonstrationMet and evidenceReady;

elements.body:
Control architecture and section camber are independent design axes.
A cambered wing could also use aerodynamic tail control. These three named
configurations are a starting comparison, not mutually exclusive physics.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Control architecture and section camber are independent design axes.
     * A cambered wing could also use aerodynamic tail control. These three named
     * configurations are a starting comparison, not mutually exclusive physics. */
enum def Evidence { unknown; passed; failed; }

attribute :>> concept = "Freely rotating main wing, provisionally symmetric, with a tail and actuated elevator-like trim tab. Tail/wing aerodynamic moments set incidence; no assumption of a powered whole-wing bearing.";
attribute :>> durability = "Avoids sailcloth flogging and sheets; retains bearing, tab linkage, tail-boom, skin/joint and wave-impact failure modes. Rigid wings are not automatically storm-proof.";

attribute :>> energy = "Low trim-energy potential from aerodynamic balance; measure bearing friction, tab hinge moment and failure-state power. No transfer of full-size Saildrone wattage to Blue Dog.";
attribute :>> sailing = "Test both tacks and low-Reynolds-number main-wing/tail interaction. Tail authority, stall, gust response and faulted-tab loads remain open.";

attribute :>> recovery = "Include main wing, tail, boom, tab, actuator and any counterweight as separate mass/volume bodies. Check free, jammed and failed trim states plus sealed, flooded and draining states.";
attribute :>> manufacturing = "Compatible in principle with printed ribs and glass skins; extra bearings, waterproof actuation, alignment and tail clearance need design.";
attribute :>> nextEvidence = "Low-speed trim bench; unpowered and jammed-tab gust tests; wet-cycle endurance; actual rig mass/CG and compartment geometry.";

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Equal development contender for the finite Gorge mission; passive trim and cloth/line wear are trade criteria, not demonstrated reliability advantages. Primary-source notes and limitations are linked through BlueDogSourceEvidence."; }

attribute :>> concept = "Owner-defined fixed-camber CrescentWing with whole-mast rotation for trim. Square-sail/downwind mode and reaching mode; no camber reversal, flap or tail mechanism is assumed. Evaluate a non-backdrivable gearbox for unpowered position holding as an actuator option, not a selected component.";

attribute :>> durability = "Avoids cloth flogging and camber-changing joints; retains skin, seam, mast-bearing and trim-drive fatigue and wave-impact loads. Verify holding torque and wear under shock, vibration, lubrication and temperature variation; do not assume every worm gearbox self-locks.";

attribute :>> energy = "Non-backdrivable gearing may eliminate motor holding current, but not controller standby power or trim energy. Compare measured daily move, hold and idle energy against tail control; include starting friction, gearbox efficiency, trim frequency and gust response. A balanced pivot can reduce drive torque.";

attribute :>> sailing = "Measure full-angle lift, drag and moment on both tacks, including drag-dominated square/downwind and lift-dominated reaching modes and transitions. Do not inherit symmetric linear-wing polars. Inspect edge geometry before assuming leading/trailing-edge interchange.";

attribute :>> recovery = "Use actual crescent/swept geometry, dry and retained-water CG, sealed volume, trim angle and failed-drive position. A self-locking drive retains the last trim angle on power loss and cannot passively feather without a release mechanism. Assess locked-angle storm/capsize states and any clutch or emergency depower strategy. Manufacturing CAD is not qualified challenge-vessel geometry.";

attribute :>> manufacturing = "Closest to existing CAD and useful for coupons/prototypes. Fixed section and rotating mast avoid tail/tab/boom parts; bearing, drive and waterproofing details remain to be designed.";

attribute :>> nextEvidence = "Inspect CAD section and stations; measure both-mode, both-tack polars, trim moments and drive energy, including depower and jam states; compare against MaxiMOOP and Oshen PC13 directly driven wingsail precedent. Bench-test motor-off holding, wet-cycle wear, daily energy and failed-power depower/recovery; include gearbox mass and CG.";

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Owner confirmed fixed camber, whole-mast trim and square/downwind plus reaching modes. Miller et al., An Alternative Wing Sail Concept for Small Autonomous Sailing Craft, DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-72739-4_1, provides analogous square-sail-derived precedent, not Blue Dog qualification. Oshen PC13 provides ocean-service precedent for directly actuated DynaRig wingsails (https://www.microtransat.org/content.php?p=2026_oshen_cstar), not evidence of identical camber or a non-backdrivable gearbox. Retain alongside tail control pending comparable measurements."; }

attribute :>> concept = "Triangular woven-polyester sail on mast and boom with sheet control. Reefing/furling is a design option requiring explicit mechanism, mass and fault analysis; battens and reinforcement are not excluded.";

attribute :>> durability = "Flogging, flutter, chafe, UV/stitching degradation and sheet wear create unattended-maintenance concerns. Durable cloth, battens and anti-chafe design can mitigate them; no lifetime failure is established.";
attribute :>> energy = "Sheet/winch energy and holding strategy must be measured; self-locking or balanced arrangements may have low static draw. Do not assume a continuously powered servo.";

attribute :>> sailing = "Both-tack sailing is conventional in principle; actual reefed and unreefed low-Re polars are needed. Compare mass and performance on the same finite-mission basis as both rigid wings.";
attribute :>> recovery = "Lower membrane mass and negligible sealed cloth volume can help, but model mast/boom buoyancy, immersion drag, trapped water and sheet snagging separately.";

attribute :>> manufacturing = "Simple sailmaking and repair, low rig-mass potential; requires sailcloth and rigging rather than printing every component. Hull FDM/glass requirement does not prohibit a soft sail.";
attribute :>> nextEvidence = "Unattended flogging/chafe/UV exposure and sheet fault tests over declared mission hours; autonomous depower and recovery demonstration.";

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Equal development contender for the finite Gorge mission. Compare measured wear, handling, energy, mass and recovery against both rigid wings over the declared exposure; future ocean endurance does not select this rig."; }
out attribute knownFailure : Boolean = mandatoryGates->ControlFunctions::exists { in gate : Evidence; gate == Evidence::failed };
out attribute evidenceComplete : Boolean = candidate.gates->ControlFunctions::forAll { in gate : Evidence; gate != Evidence::unknown };
out attribute mandatoryEvidenceComplete : Boolean = mandatoryGates->ControlFunctions::forAll { in gate : Evidence; gate != Evidence::unknown };
out attribute declaredMandatoryGatesMet : Boolean = gateCount == 7 and mandatoryGates->ControlFunctions::forAll { in gate : Evidence; gate == Evidence::passed };

// Compatibility name: this is declared gate evidence, not physical qualification.
        out attribute qualified : Boolean = declaredMandatoryGatesMet;

out attribute reliabilityStudyDisposition : String = if candidate.gates#(7) == Evidence::failed ? "Provisional study concern; assess uncertainty and evidence" else
            if candidate.gates#(7) == Evidence::passed ? "Supplied study objective met; not accepted mission reliability" else "Study evidence missing";

out attribute requirementVerdict : String = if knownFailure ? "Failed mandatory gate" else if declaredMandatoryGatesMet ? "Passed declared mandatory gates" else "Inconclusive: mandatory evidence missing";

elements.body:

elements.body:
Numerical sensitivity study of the fixed-camber reference wing.
World axes: X aft, Y starboard, Z up. Positive heel rotates about +X.
Apparent wind is horizontal, from AWA clockwise from the bow.
Upright nominal incidence fixes mast trim; heel does not retrim it.
R = Rx(heel) Rz(nominalAlpha - AWA) Rx(90 degrees) maps wing to world.
Transform wind into wing axes; solve alpha and beta together, then
rotate dimensional inviscid forces and moments back to world axes.
Moment origin is the root midchord, not the vessel center of gravity.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Numerical sensitivity study of the fixed-camber reference wing.
         * World axes: X aft, Y starboard, Z up. Positive heel rotates about +X.
         * Apparent wind is horizontal, from AWA clockwise from the bow.
         * Upright nominal incidence fixes mast trim; heel does not retrim it.
         * R = Rx(heel) Rz(nominalAlpha - AWA) Rx(90 degrees) maps wing to world.
         * Transform wind into wing axes; solve alpha and beta together, then
         * rotate dimensional inviscid forces and moments back to world axes.
         * Moment origin is the root midchord, not the vessel center of gravity. */

         * distribution. Neither station hourly fractions nor scenario counts

         * policy#5 is an optional duration budget in hours; zero disables that screen.
         * policy#7 is 1 for easterly (upstream windward), 0 for westerly. */
attribute downstream : Real = policy#(1)*(if policy#(7)>0.5 ? leewardMean else windwardMean)+(policy#(2)+policy#(3))/2;
attribute upstream : Real = policy#(1)*(if policy#(7)>0.5 ? windwardMean else leewardMean)-(policy#(2)+policy#(3))/2;
attribute duration : Real = if downstream>0 and upstream>0 ? policy#(4)/3600*(1/downstream+1/upstream) else 1000000.0;
attribute durationMargin : Real = if policy#(5)>0 ? 1-duration/policy#(5) else 1.0;

elements.body:
Keuning and Katgert (2008), A Bare Hull Resistance Prediction Method
Derived from the Results of the Delft Systematic Yacht Hull Series Extended
to Higher Speeds, equation 1.7 and tables 1-2.
Source: https://www.scribd.com/document/346520042/Keuning-2008-pdf
Untrimmed, upright, bare-hull residuary resistance only. Not a total-drag,
heeled-hull, sail-induced trim, roughness or wave-added-resistance model.
Table-1 coordinate bounds are necessary screening limits, not evidence that
every combination inside their rectangular envelope is supported.
Beyond Fn 0.60 fewer hulls were tested; this implementation's admissible
domain stops at 0.60 pending speed-dependent coverage evidence.
elements.sysx:sourceText:

     * Untrimmed, upright, bare-hull residuary resistance only. Not a total-drag,
     * heeled-hull, sail-induced trim, roughness or wave-added-resistance model.
     * Table-1 coordinate bounds are necessary screening limits, not evidence that
     * every combination inside their rectangular envelope is supported.
     * Beyond Fn 0.60 fewer hulls were tested; this implementation's admissible
     * domain stops at 0.60 pending speed-dependent coverage evidence. */

attribute positiveInputs : Real = if h#(1) > 0 and h#(2) > 0 and h#(3) > 0 and h#(4) > 0 and h#(5) > 0 and h#(6) > 0 and h#(7) > 0 and h#(8) > 0 and h#(9) > 0 and speed > 0 and density > 0 and gravity > 0 ? 1.0 else 0.0;

elements.body:
h: upright static Lwl, Bwl, canoe-body draft, canoe-body displacement,
waterplane area, LCB distance aft of forward perpendicular, LCF distance
aft of forward perpendicular, prismatic coefficient, midship coefficient.
Lengths metres, area m2, displacement m3; speed m/s, density kg/m3.
Caller rejects nonpositive dimensions and any negative domain margin.
Negative regression resistance is exposed, never silently clamped.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* h: upright static Lwl, Bwl, canoe-body draft, canoe-body displacement,
         * waterplane area, LCB distance aft of forward perpendicular, LCF distance
         * aft of forward perpendicular, prismatic coefficient, midship coefficient.
         * Lengths metres, area m2, displacement m3; speed m/s, density kg/m3.
         * Caller rejects nonpositive dimensions and any negative domain margin.
         * Negative regression resistance is exposed, never silently clamped. */
attribute a : Real [8] ordered nonunique = Coefficients(fn);
attribute ratio : Real = a#(1) + volumeLength * (a#(2)*lcb + a#(3)*cp + a#(4)*volumeArea + a#(5)*beamLength + a#(6)*centers + a#(7)*beamDraft + a#(8)*cm);

elements.body:
Geometry kernel for full-angle static buoyancy. SI metres and cubic
metres; points are in world axes with Z up and gravity along -Z.
A watertight displacement body is partitioned into nonoverlapping tetrahedra.
The external numerical solver supplies pose and solves waterline equilibrium.
Flooded voids must be excluded from displacement geometry, not made heavy
as well unless retained water is separately trapped. No dynamic recovery claim.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Geometry kernel for full-angle static buoyancy. SI metres and cubic
     * metres; points are in world axes with Z up and gravity along -Z.
     * A watertight displacement body is partitioned into nonoverlapping tetrahedra.
     * The external numerical solver supplies pose and solves waterline equilibrium.
     * Flooded voids must be excluded from displacement geometry, not made heavy
     * as well unless retained water is separately trapped. No dynamic recovery claim. */
attribute wet : Integer [*] ordered nonunique = (1..4)->ControlFunctions::select { in i : Integer; (Vertex(p,i))#(3) <= waterline };
attribute dry : Integer [*] ordered nonunique = (1..4)->ControlFunctions::select { in i : Integer; (Vertex(p,i))#(3) > waterline };

attribute clipped : Real [4] ordered nonunique = if count == 0 ? (0.0,0.0,0.0,0.0) else
            if count == 4 ? Moment(p) else PartialMoment(p,waterline,(wet,dry),count);
attribute a : Real [3] ordered nonunique = Vertex(p,order#(1));
attribute b : Real [3] ordered nonunique = Vertex(p,order#(2));
attribute c : Real [3] ordered nonunique = Vertex(p,order#(3));
attribute d : Real [3] ordered nonunique = Vertex(p,order#(4));

if count == 1 ? Moment((a,Intersection(a,b,waterline),Intersection(a,c,waterline),Intersection(a,d,waterline))) else
        if count == 3 ? Difference(Moment(p),Moment((d,Intersection(d,a,waterline),Intersection(d,b,waterline),Intersection(d,c,waterline)))) else
        TwoWet(a,b,c,d,waterline)
attribute ac : Real [3] ordered nonunique = Intersection(a,c,waterline);
attribute ad : Real [3] ordered nonunique = Intersection(a,d,waterline);
attribute bc : Real [3] ordered nonunique = Intersection(b,c,waterline);
attribute bd : Real [3] ordered nonunique = Intersection(b,d,waterline);
attribute r1 : Real [4] ordered nonunique = Moment((a,ac,ad,b));
attribute r2 : Real [4] ordered nonunique = Moment((b,ac,ad,bc));
attribute r3 : Real [4] ordered nonunique = Moment((b,ad,bc,bd));

attribute rows : Real [*] ordered nonunique = (1..count)->ControlFunctions::collect { in i : Integer;
            WetMoment((1..12)->ControlFunctions::collect { in j : Integer; vertices#(12*(i-1)+j) },waterline) };

(NumericalFunctions::sum((1..count)->ControlFunctions::collect { in i : Integer; rows#(4*i-3) }),
         NumericalFunctions::sum((1..count)->ControlFunctions::collect { in i : Integer; rows#(4*i-2) }),
         NumericalFunctions::sum((1..count)->ControlFunctions::collect { in i : Integer; rows#(4*i-1) }),
         NumericalFunctions::sum((1..count)->ControlFunctions::collect { in i : Integer; rows#(4*i) }))

elements.body:
Steady ideal axial actuator disk. Inputs: thrust N, diameter m,
fluid density kg/m3 and nonnegative axial inflow m/s. Output W.
Excludes swirl/profile losses, installation effects, crossflow,
ventilation and cavitation. Callers qualify the operating domain.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Steady ideal axial actuator disk. Inputs: thrust N, diameter m,
         * fluid density kg/m3 and nonnegative axial inflow m/s. Output W.
         * Excludes swirl/profile losses, installation effects, crossflow,
         * ventilation and cavitation. Callers qualify the operating domain. */
attribute inducedSpeed : Real = (-axialSpeedMS + RealFunctions::sqrt(axialSpeedMS * axialSpeedMS + 2 * thrustN / (densityKgM3 * diskAreaM2))) / 2;

elements.body:
SI boundary: distance m, installed through-water speed m/s,
along-track current m/s, cross-track current m/s, motor and essential
battery withdrawal W, uncertainty multiplier. Output: feasible flag,
ground speed m/s, transit s, protected energy Wh.
Steady crab-angle compensation, no wave or acceleration model.
Speed and power must be valid for the declared casualty state.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* SI boundary: distance m, installed through-water speed m/s,
         * along-track current m/s, cross-track current m/s, motor and essential
         * battery withdrawal W, uncertainty multiplier. Output: feasible flag,
         * ground speed m/s, transit s, protected energy Wh.
         * Steady crab-angle compensation, no wave or acceleration model.
         * Speed and power must be valid for the declared casualty state.
         */
attribute valid : Boolean = x#(1) >= 0 and x#(2) > 0 and x#(5) >= 0 and x#(6) > 0 and x#(7) >= 1;
attribute authority : Boolean = valid and RealFunctions::abs(x#(4)) < x#(2);
attribute ground : Real = if authority ? RealFunctions::sqrt(x#(2)*x#(2)-x#(4)*x#(4))+x#(3) else 0;
attribute feasible : Boolean = authority and ground > 0;
attribute duration : Real = if feasible ? x#(1)/ground else 0;
attribute feasibleFlag : Real = if feasible ? 1 else 0;

elements.body:
s: wind, windward flag, fouling multiplier, speed, wind-from heading,
incidence, leeway, rudder angle, heel (angles degrees). hydro:
waterline Z, restoring moment, wetted hull area, then nine upright static
canoe-body metrics from MarineResistance::Evaluate. aero moment at midchord.
Axes and equations preserve the existing body-frame convention.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
// enabled, Fx, Fy, air roll moment, signed mast moment, min Va, max |CL|, added resistance, incidence margin
        doc /* s: wind, windward flag, fouling multiplier, speed, wind-from heading,
         * incidence, leeway, rudder angle, heel (angles degrees). hydro:
         * waterline Z, restoring moment, wetted hull area, then nine upright static
         * canoe-body metrics from MarineResistance::Evaluate. aero moment at midchord.
         * Axes and equations preserve the existing body-frame convention. */
attribute awx : Real = wind * TrigFunctions::cos(theta) + v * cb;
attribute awy : Real = wind * TrigFunctions::sin(theta) - v * sb;
attribute va : Real = RealFunctions::sqrt(awx * awx + awy * awy);
attribute qa : Real = 0.5 * rho_air * va * va;
attribute xs : Real = if surface#(1)>0.5 ? surface#(2) else qa * sail_m2 * (cl * ch * awy - cd * awx) / va;
attribute ys : Real = if surface#(1)>0.5 ? surface#(3) else qa * sail_m2 * (cl * ch * awx + cd * awy) / va;
attribute drive : Real = xs * cb + ys * sb;
attribute sideNormal : Real = ys * cb - xs * sb;
attribute qk : Real = 0.5 * rho_water * v * v;
attribute qr : Real = qk * rudder_inflow_ratio * rudder_inflow_ratio;
attribute ark : Real = keel_span_m * keel_span_m / keel_m2;
attribute arr : Real = rudder_span_m * rudder_span_m / rudder_m2;
attribute clk : Real = 2 * TrigFunctions::pi / (1 + 2 / (foil_efficiency * ark)) * beta * ch;
attribute clr : Real = 2 * TrigFunctions::pi / (1 + 2 / (foil_efficiency * arr)) * (beta + delta) * ch;
attribute lk : Real = qk * keel_m2 * clk * ch;
attribute lr : Real = qr * rudder_m2 * clr * ch;
attribute dk : Real = qk * keel_m2 * (foil_cd0 * foul + clk * clk / (TrigFunctions::pi * foil_efficiency * ark));
attribute dr : Real = qr * rudder_m2 * (foil_cd0 * foul + clr * clr / (TrigFunctions::pi * foil_efficiency * arr));
attribute fn : Real = v / RealFunctions::sqrt(g * lwl_m);
attribute hullRe : Real = v * lwl_m / nu_water;
attribute hullDrag : Real = qk * wetted * cf * viscous_form_factor * foul + residuary_factor*delft#(1);
attribute resistance : Real = hullDrag + dk + dr + surface#(8);
attribute heeling : Real = (if surface#(1)>0.5 ? surface#(4) else ys * wingZ * ch) + ((lk * cb + dk * sb) * keelZ + (lr * cb + dr * sb) * rudderZ + hullDrag * sb * draft / 2) * ch;
attribute rudderTorque : Real = qr * rudder_m2 * RealFunctions::sqrt(clr * clr + foil_cd0 * foil_cd0) * hinge_fraction * rudderChord + friction_Nm;
attribute rudderEnvelopeTorque : Real = qr * rudder_m2 * foil_cl_limit * hinge_fraction * rudderChord + friction_Nm;
attribute waterVMG : Real = (if upwind ? 1 else -1) * v * TrigFunctions::cos(theta + beta);
attribute wingRe : Real = (if surface#(1)>0.5 ? surface#(6) else va) * wingChord / nu_air;
attribute keelRe : Real = v * keelChord / nu_water;
attribute rudderRe : Real = v * rudder_inflow_ratio * rudderChord / nu_water;
attribute mastMomentCoefficient : Real = aero#(3)*q#(24)+((if s#(5)<0 ? 1-d#(9) else d#(9))-0.5)*normalCoefficient;
attribute wingTorque : Real = if surface#(1)>0.5 ? RealFunctions::abs(surface#(5))+friction_Nm else MarineActuation::MastTorque(rho_air,va,sail_m2,wingChord,mastMomentCoefficient,friction_Nm);
attribute harvestPower : Real = panel_m2 * peak_irradiance_W_m2 * panel_efficiency * harvest_efficiency * solar_resource_factor;

attribute dayRate : Real = (if harvestPower >= averagePower ? NumericalFunctions::min((harvestPower - averagePower) * charge_efficiency, charge_C_rate * battery_Wh) else (harvestPower - averagePower) / discharge_efficiency) - self_discharge_W;
attribute cycleEnergy : Real = dark_hours * nightRate + solar_hours * dayRate;
attribute reserveMargin : Real = initial_fraction * usable_fraction * battery_Wh + dark_hours * nightRate - reserve_Wh;
attribute yawResidual : Real = (-ys*sailX+(lr*cb+dr*sb)*rudderX-(if surface#(1)>0.5 ? surface#(5) else qa*sail_m2*wingChord*mastMomentCoefficient))/10;
attribute wingLiftMargin : Real = if surface#(1)>0.5 ? NumericalFunctions::min(1-surface#(7)/wing_cl_limit,surface#(9)) else 1-RealFunctions::abs(cl)/wing_cl_limit;
attribute wingResultant : Real = if surface#(1)>0.5 ? RealFunctions::sqrt(xs*xs+ys*ys) else qa*sail_m2*RealFunctions::sqrt(cl*cl+cd*cd);

(surgeResidual, swayResidual, yawResidual, rollResidual, wingLiftMargin, keelLiftMargin, rudderLiftMargin, keelAngleMargin, rudderAngleMargin, wingDriveMargin, rudderDriveMargin, froudeMargin, wingReMargin, keelReMargin, rudderReMargin, cycleMargin, reserveMarginScaled, peakMargin, waterVMG, v, cl, cd, clk, clr, drive, resistance, heeling, righting, wingTorque, rudderTorque, averagePower, peakPower, harvestPower, cycleEnergy, reserveMargin, wingRe, keelRe, rudderRe, ys, lk, lr, hullDrag, dk, dr, wingResultant, keelResultant, rudderResultant, delftResistanceMargin, delftDomain4, delftDomain5, delftDomain6, delftDomain7, delftDomain8, delftDomain9, delftDomain10, delftDomain11, delftDomain12, delftDomain13, delftDomain14, delftDomain15, delftDomain16, delftDomain17, delftDomain18, delftDomain19, delftDomain20, delftDomain21)

attribute driveEfficiencies : Real = if p#(2) > 0 and p#(2) <= 1 and p#(3) > 0 and p#(3) <= 1 ? 1.0 else 0.0;
attribute wingDuty : Real = if p#(7) >= 0 and p#(8) >= 0 and p#(7)+p#(8) <= 1.000000000001 ? 1.0 else 0.0;
attribute rudderDuty : Real = if p#(10) >= 0 and p#(10) <= 1 ? 1.0 else 0.0;
attribute positiveSpeed : Real = if s#(4) > 0 ? 1.0 else 0.0;
attribute positiveWettedArea : Real = if hydro#(3) > 0 ? 1.0 else 0.0;

elements.body:
SI magnitudes. Neutral log profile and strip quadrature are a first
surface-layer screen, not a stability-corrected wave boundary-layer model.
Wave resistance is an explicitly uncalibrated sensitivity coefficient.
Deep-water wave/current action transport assumes slow spatial variation;
a uniform river current is not itself a shoaling transition.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* SI magnitudes. Neutral log profile and strip quadrature are a first
     * surface-layer screen, not a stability-corrected wave boundary-layer model.
     * Wave resistance is an explicitly uncalibrated sensitivity coefficient.
     * Deep-water wave/current action transport assumes slow spatial variation;
     * a uniform river current is not itself a shoaling transition. */
attribute ratio : Real = if x#(8)>0.5 ? OpenSysMLMathFunctions::ln(height/x#(3))/OpenSysMLMathFunctions::ln(x#(2)/x#(3)) else 1;

// reference 10 m wind, effective fetch, gravity; SMB deep-water growth.
        attribute wind : Real = NumericalFunctions::max(x#(1),0.1);
attribute height : Real = if x#(1)>0 ? 0.283*wind*wind/x#(3)*hTanh else 0;

// amplitude, k, intrinsic omega, depth z<=0, phase, direction, gravity.
        attribute decay : Real = OpenSysMLMathFunctions::exp(x#(2)*NumericalFunctions::min(x#(4),0));

// encounter omega, rigid mass, added mass, stiffness, radiation damping, extra damping.
        attribute realPart : Real = x#(4)-x#(1)*x#(1)*(x#(2)+x#(3));

// Wing torque, rudder torque, battery Wh; same duty model as Core.
        attribute wing : Real [3] ordered nonunique = MarineActuation::DrivePower(x#(1),p#(19),p#(3),p#(2),p#(4),p#(5),p#(6),p#(7),p#(8));
if coverage > 0 ? ((1-eastProbability)*(if westPass ? westHours else 0) + eastProbability*(if eastPass ? eastHours else 0))/coverage else 0

elements.body:
Arithmetic for two mutually exclusive full-passage regime hypotheses.
Caller must validate 0<=p<=1, finite nonnegative times for passing cases,
and report coverage=0 as no conditional time (not a zero-hour passage).
Station hourly direction fractions are not full-passage probabilities.
Coverage is a route-screen sensitivity, not system reliability.

elements.body: Reusable U.S. Inland Rules interpretation. Supplied facts and candidate checks are conditional assessments, not established legal compliance. The mission navigation adapter consumes the pair assessment; equipment and other obligations remain separately assessed.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Reusable U.S. Inland Rules interpretation. Supplied facts and candidate checks are conditional assessments, not established legal compliance. The mission navigation adapter consumes the pair assessment; equipment and other obligations remain separately assessed.*/
enum def Truth { yes; no; unknown; }
enum def Mode { sail; power; rowing; towingAstern; pushing; towed; pushed; trawling; fishing; nuc; ram; dredging; diving; mineClearance; pilot; seaplane; wig; airCushion; mooredBarge; }
enum def Side { portSide; starboardSide; ahead; aft; unresolved; }

elements.body: Rules 1-8. Candidate-action and evidence checks, not a sensor estimator or safe-speed optimizer. Judgment inputs require external evidence; no universal CPA/time/turn threshold is invented. Rule 4 applies general duties in all visibility. Rule 3 definitions are externally classified facts. Rule 2 departure requires assessed necessity, never a blanket emergency exemption.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Rules 1-8. Candidate-action and evidence checks, not a sensor estimator or safe-speed optimizer. Judgment inputs require external evidence; no universal CPA/time/turn threshold is invented. Rule 4 applies general duties in all visibility. Rule 3 definitions are externally classified facts. Rule 2 departure requires assessed necessity, never a blanket emergency exemption.*/
out attribute rule2DepartureAssessmentSupported : Boolean = factsKnown and immediateDanger and departureNecessary and departureLimitedToNecessity and specialCircumstancesReviewed;
out attribute rule5Supported : Boolean = factsKnown and visualLookout and hearingLookout and appropriateMeansUsed;

out attribute rule6Supported : Boolean = factsKnown and visibilityReviewed and trafficDensityReviewed and maneuverabilityReviewed and backgroundLightsReviewed and weatherCurrentReviewed and draftDepthReviewed and (not radarOperational or radarLimitsReviewed);
out attribute rule7RiskPresent : Boolean = riskAssessment != Truth::no or (approaching and bearingSteady) or otherRiskEvidence;
out attribute rule7FurtherAppraisalRequired : Boolean = not factsKnown or (largeTowOrCloseRange and approaching) or (radarOperational and (not radarLongRangeUsed or not radarPlottingUsed));
out attribute rule8MonitorRequired : Boolean = not finallyClear;

out attribute rule8CandidateSupported : Boolean = factsKnown and positiveAction and earlyAction and substantialAction and noNewCloseQuarters and safePassingDistance and (finallyClear or effectivenessMonitored) and (not speedReductionNecessary or speedReduced);

out attribute assessmentSupported : Boolean = inlandWaters and jurisdictionReviewed and localProvisionsSatisfied and rule5Supported and rule6Supported and not rule7FurtherAppraisalRequired and rule8CandidateSupported;

elements.body: Rules 8(f), 9 and 10. River encounter priority is in Assess; signal exchanges are in Signals. A necessary maintenance/cable exemption is a supplied, clause-limited determination: tssSupported is not overall compliance, and exemptionScopeReviewRequired remains true. Facts about legally designated schemes and geography require authoritative review.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Rules 8(f), 9 and 10. River encounter priority is in Assess; signal exchanges are in Signals. A necessary maintenance/cable exemption is a supplied, clause-limited determination: tssSupported is not overall compliance, and exemptionScopeReviewRequired remains true. Facts about legally designated schemes and geography require authoritative review.*/
out attribute channelNonImpediment : Boolean = channel and (((ownSailing or lengthM < 20) and otherConfined) or (ownFishing and otherNavigatingChannel) or (crossingChannel and otherConfined));
out attribute channelCrossingProhibited : Boolean = channel and crossingChannel and otherConfined and crossingImpede;
out attribute channelBendSignalRequired : Boolean = channel and nearObscuredBend;
out attribute channelAvoidAnchor : Boolean = channel and anchors and avoidAnchoringPracticable;

out attribute channelSupported : Boolean = factsKnown and lengthM > 0 and not channelCrossingProhibited and not channelAvoidAnchor and (not (channel and followingChannel) or safePracticableStarboardEdge) and (not channelBendSignalRequired or (caution and bendSignal)) and (not channelNonImpediment or (earlySeaRoom and providedNonImpediment));
out attribute limitedTssExemption : Boolean = necessaryMaintenanceExemption or necessaryCableExemption;
out attribute inshorePermitted : Boolean = lengthM < 20 or ownSailing or ownFishing or not canUseLane or destinationException or immediateDanger;
out attribute separationEntryPermitted : Boolean = crossesLane or joinsLeaves or immediateDanger or fishingInZone;
out attribute tssNonImpediment : Boolean = tss and otherFollowingLane and (ownFishing or ((lengthM < 20 or ownSailing) and otherPower));

out attribute ordinaryTssGeometrySupported : Boolean = (not usesLane or (followsFlow and clearSeparation and (not joinsLeaves or atTermination or smallJoinAngle))) and (not crossesLane or (not crossingAvoidable and rightAngleHeading)) and (not usesInshore or inshorePermitted) and (not entersSeparationZone or separationEntryPermitted) and (not nearTermination or terminationCaution) and (not anchors or not avoidAnchoringPracticable) and (usesLane or wideAvoidanceMargin);

out attribute tssSupported : Boolean = factsKnown and lengthM > 0 and (not tss or ((ordinaryTssGeometrySupported or limitedTssExemption) and (not tssNonImpediment or (earlySeaRoom and providedNonImpediment))));
out attribute exemptionScopeReviewRequired : Boolean = tss and limitedTssExemption;

elements.body: Rule 19; no stand-on assignment is produced. Candidate restrictions use assessed relative geometry, radar-only acquisition and risk. Port/toward-target avoidance is treated conservatively without an automatic exception; any necessary departure needs separate Rule 2 assessment.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Rule 19; no stand-on assignment is produced. Candidate restrictions use assessed relative geometry, radar-only acquisition and risk. Port/toward-target avoidance is treated conservatively without an automatic exception; any necessary departure needs separate Rule 2 assessment.*/
out attribute applicable : Boolean = not inSight and inOrNearRestricted;
out attribute avoidanceRequired : Boolean = applicable and radarOnly and (risk != Truth::no or closeQuarters);
out attribute avoidPortTurn : Boolean = avoidanceRequired and courseAlteration and forwardOfBeam and not ownOvertaking;
out attribute avoidTowardTarget : Boolean = avoidanceRequired and courseAlteration and abeamOrAbaft;
out attribute minimumSpeedRequired : Boolean = applicable and risk != Truth::no and (fogSignalForward or cannotAvoidForwardClose);
out attribute engineReadinessRequired : Boolean = applicable and enginePowered;

out attribute candidateSupported : Boolean = factsKnown and (not applicable or (safeSpeedAdapted and (not engineReadinessRequired or enginesReady) and (not avoidanceRequired or earlyAvoidance) and (not avoidPortTurn or not portTurn) and (not avoidTowardTarget or not towardTargetTurn) and (not minimumSpeedRequired or (minimumSteerageSpeed and extremeCaution and (not allWayOffNecessary or allWayOff)))));

elements.body: Rules 20-31. Pattern obligations and size boundaries, not automatic image recognition. Outputs are simultaneous: ordinary/status/anchor/tow supplements must be combined by applicability. Specialized group tow layouts, fishing optional signals and approved alternatives are assessed separately. Rule 28 is reserved in Inland Rules; no constrained-by-draft privilege is invented.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Rules 20-31. Pattern obligations and size boundaries, not automatic image recognition. Outputs are simultaneous: ordinary/status/anchor/tow supplements must be combined by applicability. Specialized group tow layouts, fishing optional signals and approved alternatives are assessed separately. Rule 28 is reserved in Inland Rules; no constrained-by-draft privilege is invented.*/
out attribute valid : Boolean = factsKnown and lengthM > 0 and towLengthM >= 0 and towBreadthM >= 0 and objectLengthM >= 0 and not (anchored and aground);
out attribute displayLights : Boolean = night or (restrictedVisibility and lightsCarried) or lightsDeemedNecessary;
out attribute displayShapes : Boolean = not night;

out attribute smallSailAlternative : Boolean = not sailAlsoPowered and (mode == Mode::rowing or (mode == Mode::sail and lengthM < 7 and not normalSailLightsPracticable and chooseSmallSailAlternative));
out attribute smallPowerAlternative : Boolean = (mode == Mode::power or sailAlsoPowered) and lengthM < 12 and chooseSmallPowerAlternative;
out attribute smallStatusExemption : Boolean = lengthM < 12 and chooseSmallStatusExemption and mode != Mode::diving;
out attribute anchorExemption : Boolean = anchored and ((lengthM < 7 and awayFromNavigation) or (lengthM < 20 and specialAnchorage));

out attribute bargeLightsRequired : Boolean = mode == Mode::mooredBarge and not shelteredBargeExemption and not geographicBargeExemption and not (lengthM < 20 and specialAnchorage) and (mooredProjectsIntoChannel or mooredWidthBelow80 or groupMoreThanTwoWide or groupWidthOver25 or not mooredParallel);

out attribute ordinaryUnderwayPattern : String = if smallSailAlternative ? "All-round white OR white torch/lantern displayed in time to prevent collision" else if (mode == Mode::sail or mode == Mode::rowing) and not sailAlsoPowered ? "Sidelights and sternlight; under 20 m combined masthead lantern is an option" else if smallPowerAlternative ? "All-round white and sidelights" else if lengthM >= 50 ? "Two masthead lights, sidelights and sternlight" else "Forward masthead, sidelights and sternlight";

out attribute statusPattern : String = if mode == Mode::trawling ? "Green over white; two cones apexes together; aft higher masthead required at 50 m or more; sidelights/sternlight when making way" else if mode == Mode::fishing ? "Red over white; two cones apexes together; sidelights/sternlight when making way" else if mode == Mode::nuc ? (if smallStatusExemption ? "Rule 27 small-vessel display exemption selected" else "Two red all-round lights; two balls; sidelights/sternlight when making way") else if mode == Mode::ram or mode == Mode::dredging ? (if smallStatusExemption ? "Rule 27 small-vessel display exemption selected" else "Red-white-red all-round; ball-diamond-ball; power underway lights when making way") else if mode == Mode::diving ? (if divingSmallDisplay ? "Red-white-red all-round and rigid code flag A at least 1 m; all-round flag visibility" else "RAM display plus obstruction/passable-side displays when applicable") else if mode == Mode::mineClearance ? (if smallStatusExemption ? "Rule 27 small-vessel display exemption selected" else "Three green all-round lights or three balls in prescribed arrangement; dangerous within 1000 m") else if mode == Mode::pilot ? out attribute longTowDiamondRequired : Boolean = not compositeUnit and towLengthM > 200 and (mode == Mode::towingAstern or mode == Mode::towed);

out attribute towPattern : String = if compositeUnit ? "Rule 23 power-driven composite unit" else if mode == Mode::towingAstern ? "Vertical masthead stack, sidelights, sternlight, yellow towing light above sternlight; Rule 23 masthead positioning applies" else if mode == Mode::pushing ? "Two masthead lights, sidelights, two towing lights; applicable river alternative requires review" else if mode == Mode::pushed ? "Forward sidelights and special flashing light" else if mode == Mode::towed and partiallySubmerged ? "White all-round outline lights and aft diamond" else if mode == Mode::towed ? "Sidelights and sternlight; alongside/group arrangements require review" else "No tow pattern";

elements.body: Rules 32-37. Inland signal meanings differ from International maneuver signals. shortToleranceS is an explicit engineering interpretation of about one second. Signals are obligations/due events, not proof they were emitted or heard. Radio agreement removes only applicable passage-whistle duties, not danger/fog signals. Distress selection must be an authorized Annex IV signal; no transmitter is actuated.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Rules 32-37. Inland signal meanings differ from International maneuver signals. shortToleranceS is an explicit engineering interpretation of about one second. Signals are obligations/due events, not proof they were emitted or heard. Radio agreement removes only applicable passage-whistle duties, not danger/fog signals. Distress selection must be an authorized Annex IV signal; no transmitter is actuated.*/
out attribute blastDurationsSupported : Boolean = shortToleranceS >= 0 and shortBlastS >= 1-shortToleranceS and shortBlastS <= 1+shortToleranceS and prolongedBlastS >= 4 and prolongedBlastS <= 6;
out attribute dangerSignalRequired : Boolean = inSight and approaching and doubt;
out attribute dangerMinimumShortBlasts : Integer = if dangerSignalRequired ? 5 else 0;
out attribute maneuverSignalRequired : Boolean = inSight and powerPair and underway and ((meetingCrossing and withinHalfMile) or overtaking) and not passingAgreementReached;

out attribute maneuverShortBlasts : Integer = if not maneuverSignalRequired ? 0 else if asternPropulsion ? 3 else if overtaking ? (if intendOvertakeStarboard ? 1 else 2) else if intendLeaveOnPort ? 1 else 2;
out attribute answerSameSignalRequired : Boolean = inSight and powerPair and otherProposalHeard and proposalAccepted and not passingAgreementReached;
out attribute precautionUntilAgreementRequired : Boolean = inSight and powerPair and otherProposalHeard and not proposalAccepted;
out attribute prolongedBendSignalRequired : Boolean = bendOrObstruction or heardBendSignal;
out attribute prolongedDepartureSignalRequired : Boolean = leavingBerth and mode == Mode::power;
out attribute smallFogAlternative : Boolean = chooseSmallEfficientAlternative and (lengthM < 12 or (lengthM < 20 and (anchored or aground)));
out attribute fogAnchorExemption : Boolean = anchored and not aground and specialAnchorage and lengthM < 20 and mode != Mode::fishing and mode != Mode::trawling and not legallyRam;

out attribute fogPattern : String = if not restrictedVisibility ? "None" else if fogAnchorExemption ? "Special anchorage exemption" else if smallFogAlternative ? "Other efficient sound" else if legallyRam or mode == Mode::fishing or mode == Mode::trawling ? "One prolonged then two short" else if aground ? "Anchor bell pattern plus three distinct strokes before and after; gong at 100 m" else if anchored ? "Rapid bell about 5 s; gong about 5 s after bell at 100 m" else if compositeUnit or mode == Mode::power or mode == Mode::pilot or mode == Mode::seaplane or mode == Mode::wig or mode == Mode::airCushion ? (if makingWay ? "One prolonged" else "Two prolonged separated by about 2 s") else if mode == Mode::towed and mannedLastTow ? "One prolonged then three short, after tug when practicable" else if mode == Mode::towed ? "No manned-tow signal duty" else "One prolonged then two short";

out attribute fogSignalIntervalMaxS : Real = if not restrictedVisibility or fogAnchorExemption or (mode == Mode::towed and not mannedLastTow) ? 0 else if not smallFogAlternative and (anchored or aground) and not legallyRam and mode != Mode::fishing and mode != Mode::trawling ? 60 else 120;
out attribute fogSignalDue : Boolean = fogSignalIntervalMaxS > 0 and elapsedFogSignalS >= fogSignalIntervalMaxS;
out attribute pilotIdentityOptionalBlasts : Integer = if pilotDuty ? 4 else 0;
out attribute distressSignalRequired : Boolean = distress and assistanceRequired;
out attribute distressSignalMisuse : Boolean = distressSignalChosen and not distressSignalRequired;
out attribute attentionSignalPermitted : Boolean = attentionNeeded and attentionSignalNonConfusing and attentionDoesNotDazzle;

out attribute candidateSupported : Boolean = factsKnown and lengthM > 0 and elapsedFogSignalS >= 0 and blastDurationsSupported and signalEquipmentAccepted and (not efficientSoundRequired or efficientSoundAvailable) and (not smallFogAlternative or efficientSoundAvailable) and not distressSignalMisuse and (not distressSignalRequired or distressSignalChosen) and (not attentionNeeded or attentionSignalPermitted);
out attribute legallyRam : Boolean = mode == Mode::ram or mode == Mode::dredging or mode == Mode::diving;

elements.body: Rules 21/22 and selected Annex I numerical demands. Color region checks are screening only; optical certification/evidence remains required. Red corner coordinates are ordered around their convex boundary, not read as a self-crossing polygon in table-column order. White uses the stated boundary order. This interpretation requires review against the incorporated CIE standard. Units: m, degrees, nautical miles, candela, flashes/minute.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Rules 21/22 and selected Annex I numerical demands. Color region checks are screening only; optical certification/evidence remains required. Red corner coordinates are ordered around their convex boundary, not read as a self-crossing polygon in table-column order. White uses the stated boundary order. This interpretation requires review against the incorporated CIE standard. Units: m, degrees, nautical miles, candela, flashes/minute.*/

out attribute requiredRangeNm : Real = if submergedTow ? 3 else if kind == LightKind::specialFlashing ? 2 else if kind == LightKind::masthead ? (if lengthM >= 50 ? 6 else if lengthM >= 20 ? 5 else if lengthM >= 12 ? 3 else 2) else if kind == LightKind::portSide or kind == LightKind::starboardSide ? (if lengthM >= 50 ? 3 else if lengthM >= 12 ? 2 else 1) else if lengthM >= 50 ? 3 else 2;

out attribute requiredArcMinDeg : Real = if kind == LightKind::masthead ? 225 else if kind == LightKind::portSide or kind == LightKind::starboardSide ? 112.5 else if kind == LightKind::stern or kind == LightKind::towing ? 135 else if kind == LightKind::specialFlashing ? 180 else 360;
out attribute requiredArcMaxDeg : Real = if kind == LightKind::specialFlashing ? 225 else requiredArcMinDeg;

out attribute requiredColor : InlandExtended::Color = if kind == LightKind::portSide or kind == LightKind::allRoundRed or kind == LightKind::flashingRed ? Color::red else if kind == LightKind::starboardSide or kind == LightKind::allRoundGreen ? Color::green else if kind == LightKind::towing or kind == LightKind::specialFlashing or kind == LightKind::flashingYellow ? Color::yellow else Color::white;

out attribute minimumIntensityCd : Real = if requiredRangeNm == 1 ? 0.686/0.8 else if requiredRangeNm == 2 ? 0.686*4/(0.8*0.8) else if requiredRangeNm == 3 ? 0.686*9/(0.8*0.8*0.8) else if requiredRangeNm == 5 ? 0.686*25/(0.8*0.8*0.8*0.8*0.8) else 0.686*36/(0.8*0.8*0.8*0.8*0.8*0.8);
out attribute requiredVerticalOuterDeg : Real = if unmannedBarge ? 0 else if sailingUnderway ? 25 else 7.5;
out attribute requiredOuterIntensityFraction : Real = if unmannedBarge ? 1 else if sailingUnderway ? 0.5 else 0.6;

out attribute flashSupported : Boolean = if kind == LightKind::specialFlashing ? flashesPerMinute >= 50 and flashesPerMinute <= 70 else if kind == LightKind::flashingRed or kind == LightKind::flashingYellow ? flashesPerMinute >= 120 else true;

out attribute chromaticitySupported : Boolean = if requiredColor == Color::white ? whiteChromaticity else if requiredColor == Color::red ? redChromaticity else if requiredColor == Color::green ? greenChromaticity else yellowChromaticity;

out attribute fixtureSupported : Boolean = factsKnown and lengthM > 0 and nominalArcDeg >= requiredArcMinDeg and nominalArcDeg <= requiredArcMaxDeg and measuredRangeNm >= requiredRangeNm and minimumMeasuredIntensityCd >= minimumIntensityCd and chromaticitySupported and chromaticityEvidenceAccepted and flashSupported and horizontalSectorEvidenceAccepted and verticalSectorEvidenceAccepted and installationPositionEvidenceAccepted and screensEvidenceAccepted;

elements.body: Annex I selected installation constraints. Special layouts/high-speed alternatives require reviewed drawings. Small commensurate shape sizes are externally assessed. Applicable hull/gunwale datum must be used. Does not certify every Annex I clause.

elements.body: Annex III checks for a fitted whistle/bell. Small efficient alternatives are in Signals. Higher sound level is conservatively used at overlapping 450/800 Hz boundaries. Audibility range is not a detection guarantee; gong level needs separate measurement.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Annex III checks for a fitted whistle/bell. Small efficient alternatives are in Signals. Higher sound level is conservatively used at overlapping 450/800 Hz boundaries. Audibility range is not a detection guarantee; gong level needs separate measurement.*/
out attribute minimumFundamentalHz : Real = if lengthM >= 200 ? 70 else if lengthM >= 75 ? 130 else 250;
out attribute maximumFundamentalHz : Real = if lengthM >= 200 ? 200 else if lengthM >= 75 ? 350 else 700;
