out attribute bandValid : Boolean = bandHz >= 180*0.99 and bandHz <= (if lengthM >= 20 ? 700*1.01 else 2100*1.01);

out attribute combinedSupported : Boolean = if combined ? whistleSpacingM <= 100 and simultaneous and minimumFrequencyDifferenceHz >= 10 and (if twoWhistles ? higherFrequencyConforms else conformingWhistleFraction >= 2.0/3.0) else whistleSpacingM <= 100 or not simultaneous;

out attribute whistleSupported : Boolean = factsKnown and lengthM > 0 and fundamentalHz >= minimumFundamentalHz and fundamentalHz <= maximumFundamentalHz and bandValid and measuredBandDb >= minimumBandDb and forward45Db >= minimumBandDb-4 and otherDirectionsDb >= minimumBandDb-10 and listeningPostDb <= 110 and (not directional or forwardAligned) and positioningReviewed and combinedSupported;

elements.body: Combines independently evaluated domains for one consistent candidate and observation. Caller supplies native outputs, not manually invented pass flags. No complete compliance verdict. metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Western rounding mark near Stevenson: NOAA ENC US5WA3DK and USCG LLNR 11835 identify red Lighted Buoy 16. Round to port through north, west and south offset checkpoints in that order. Use the nominal charted position, never contact or attach to the aid. The 80 m exclusion and 220 m checkpoint extent are project allocations, not statutory stand-offs."; }

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Bingen start/finish reference downstream of Bingen Point boat ramp: green Lighted Buoy 39, NOAA ENC US5WA3DP and USCG LLNR 11985. The virtual gate extends south from the nominal charted buoy position. Launch and retrieval at Bingen Point are outside the scored circuit. Confirm the actual buoy and current notices before launch."; }

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "2026-10-07 Northwest LNM week 40 page 2 locates railroad bridge work at White Salmon confluence, RM 168.2, through 2026-12-31. The derrick barge stays on station outside work hours. Source: https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/sites/default/files/pdf/lnms/lnm13402026.pdf . Exclude a 250 m analysis buffer around the published point for this snapshot."; }

metadata issue : ModelingMetadata::Issue { text = "The radius is a conservative scenario allocation, not a surveyed work footprint or statutory stand-off. Replace with confirmed work extent and current notices before release; do not silently expire this exclusion using the computer clock."; }

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Select the charted Hood River lifting span, closed, for both legs. ENC US5WA3DP LNAM 0226241BDFAB1596 supplies the polygon and conservative 20.4 m closed clearance; the Port reports 20.42 m at its stated average river height. Adjacent spans without clearance evidence are excluded. No bridge opening is part of the mission. Vertical acceptance subtracts measured pool rise, vessel air draft including motion, and a 2 m project uncertainty allowance from chart clearance. PDR must verify the local stage datum; launch must check current works and pool stage. The 10 m pier allowance is a planning allocation, not a legal stand-off."; }
attribute coordinateDatum : String = "WGS84 longitude/latitude degrees; bearings clockwise from true north; offsets in meters";

metadata referenceLengthBasis : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Half the complete chart-domain reference circuit including the buoy rounding generated from this gate and clearance configuration by tools.boat_analysis.environment.routing. This equivalent leg length preserves full circuit distance in the symmetric sizing calculation; the mission simulation uses the distinct legs. This is a nominal sizing-analysis distance, not a prescribed sailing track; tacks and avoidance increase traveled distance. Regeneration checks this value against the chart-derived route."; }

metadata routingRationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Initial routing allocations for the small-vessel analysis: chart depth at least 2 m, 30 m from charted land/obstructions and 50 m from excluded charted areas. These are project planning margins, not legal stand-off distances. Actual draft, pool stage, maneuvering, uncertainty and bridge clearances require separate assessment. Grid resolution is a numerical setting, not a vessel requirement."; }

attribute crossingSequence : String = "Cross Bingen gate downstream; pass north, west and south of buoy 16 in order, keeping the buoy to port; cross Bingen gate upstream to finish. Maintain the modeled marker exclusion throughout. Launch and retrieval are outside the scored course.";

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "The route stays in Bonneville Pool. Gate segments are defined relative to existing aids, with 80 m minimum nominal marker offset. Chart-derived polygons, water depth and local notices constrain route planning; neither the marker-to-marker chord nor the commercial fairway is the whole permitted sailing corridor. Completion has no elapsed-time deadline. A computational horizon reports censoring rather than failure."; }

metadata issue : ModelingMetadata::Issue { text = "Gate proposal for mission analysis, not a launch release. Verify complete segment clearance and maneuvering/drift margins, current MSI notices, current pool stage, bridge passage and autonomous traffic avoidance. A route through charted water does not establish safe operation. No universal vessel stand-off distance is inferred from navigation rules."; }

elements.body:
Independent trans-gorge autonomous sailing challenge.
Inspired by the structure of the Microtransat rules:
https://microtransat.org/content.php?p=rules&top=rules
This is a separate project challenge, not a Microtransat entry or endorsement.
Vessel architecture and communications technology are unrestricted; overall length is limited to 1.2 m.
The Gorge is the proving ground for a longer-term voyage toward Hawaii.
Marker-referenced virtual gates are defined in TransGorgeCourse.
There is no completion deadline. The vehicle defines candidate environmental qualification profiles; no dam passage is permitted.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Independent trans-gorge autonomous sailing challenge.
     * Inspired by the structure of the Microtransat rules:
     * https://microtransat.org/content.php?p=rules&top=rules
     * This is a separate project challenge, not a Microtransat entry or endorsement.
     * Vessel architecture and communications technology are unrestricted; overall length is limited to 1.2 m.
     * The Gorge is the proving ground for a longer-term voyage toward Hawaii.
     * Marker-referenced virtual gates are defined in TransGorgeCourse.
     * There is no completion deadline. The vehicle defines candidate environmental qualification profiles; no dam passage is permitted.
     */

elements.body: The vessel shall deliver position, operating mode and health updates at intervals no greater than 30 seconds while the monitoring link is available.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall deliver position, operating mode and health updates at intervals no greater than 30 seconds while the monitoring link is available. */

elements.body: C-020 governs autonomous continuation, retention and telemetry replay during monitoring-link outages.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* C-020 governs autonomous continuation, retention and telemetry replay during monitoring-link outages. */

metadata issue : ModelingMetadata::Issue { text = "LTE-M-class throughput is a provisional vehicle design assumption, not a mandated challenge technology. End-to-end delivery qualification and stale-data presentation are allocated to the vehicle."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall permit remote emergency abort or manual control when a command link is available.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall permit remote emergency abort or manual control when a command link is available. */

elements.body: Use disqualifies the attempt as unassisted.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Use disqualifies the attempt as unassisted. */

metadata issue : ModelingMetadata::Issue { text = "Owner-approved policy: autonomous safety abort does not wait for operator contact. Recovery may use motor propulsion; operator-directed relocation or motor-sailing after abort never restores qualification."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall comply with the U.S. Inland Navigation Rules (33 CFR parts 83 through 90) and applicable local navigation provisions throughout the attempt on the approved Gorge course.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall comply with the U.S. Inland Navigation Rules (33 CFR parts 83 through 90) and applicable local navigation provisions throughout the attempt on the approved Gorge course.*/

elements.body: Evaluate the actual encounter and visibility conditions, including lookout, collision-risk assessment, avoidance action, safe speed, overtaking, sailing encounters and narrow-channel obligations. A safety action takes precedence over preserving attempt qualification.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Evaluate the actual encounter and visibility conditions, including lookout, collision-risk assessment, avoidance action, safe speed, overtaking, sailing encounters and narrow-channel obligations. A safety action takes precedence over preserving attempt qualification. */

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "USCG Navigation Rules: https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/navigation-rules-amalgamated . Detailed encounter cases and quantitative acceptance allocations belong to the vehicle analysis, not the independent challenge. Small size and sail propulsion do not exempt the vessel from collision avoidance or channel non-impediment."; }

elements.body: C-028 identifies entrant applicability review; C-029 controls the organizer rule and notice baseline; C-030 governs entry evidence; C-031 identifies operator safety intervention; C-032 governs adjudication. These preserve the C-007 entry and qualification policy.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment processResponsibilities /* C-028 identifies entrant applicability review; C-029 controls the organizer rule and notice baseline; C-030 governs entry evidence; C-031 identifies operator safety intervention; C-032 governs adjudication. These preserve the C-007 entry and qualification policy. */

elements.body: The vessel shall remain outside waters prohibited to the attempt configuration.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall remain outside waters prohibited to the attempt configuration. */

elements.body: Include dam restricted areas, lock approaches excluded by the challenge, and applicable temporary safety/security zones or closures. Use the chart and notice set applicable to the attempt.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Include dam restricted areas, lock approaches excluded by the challenge, and applicable temporary safety/security zones or closures. Use the chart and notice set applicable to the attempt. */

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "33 CFR 207.718 defines site-specific dam restrictions and lock-approach authority: https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-II/part-207/section-207.718 . The course stays between the dams and requires no lock passage. Do not replace mapped restrictions with an invented universal stand-off radius."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall complete the course without collision with other waterway users.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall complete the course without collision with other waterway users. */

elements.body: The operating context includes commercial tows, passenger vessels, fishing craft, recreational powerboats, sailing vessels and people in the water. Channel non-impediment and encounter conduct remain independently required by C-007. The vehicle analysis defines representative and adverse traffic scenarios and assesses maneuver feasibility.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* The operating context includes commercial tows, passenger vessels, fishing craft, recreational powerboats, sailing vessels and people in the water. Channel non-impediment and encounter conduct remain independently required by C-007. The vehicle analysis defines representative and adverse traffic scenarios and assesses maneuver feasibility. */

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "The course is shared water, not a closed test range. Typical traffic and uncertainty in other users' behavior are part of mission validation; AIS absence is not evidence of clear water. Numeric separation allocations must be justified by encounter geometry and vessel performance."; }
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "C-000 includes this obligation independently of course progress or elapsed time."; }
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "C-000 includes this obligation independently of course progress or elapsed time."; }

elements.body: The vessel overall length shall not exceed 1.2 m.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel overall length shall not exceed 1.2 m. */
require constraint lengthLimit { measuredOverallLength > 0 [m] and measuredOverallLength <= maximumOverallLength }

elements.body: Measure maximum fore-and-aft extent, including rudders, rig projections, antennas and other equipment, across normal operating configurations. Hull arrangement is unrestricted.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Measure maximum fore-and-aft extent, including rudders, rig projections, antennas and other equipment, across normal operating configurations. Hull arrangement is unrestricted. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Half the Microtransat 2.4 m overall-length entry limit; owner-selected challenge constraint."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall autonomously terminate qualification when a required safety capability is lost.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall autonomously terminate qualification when a required safety capability is lost. */

elements.body: A demonstrated backup preserving the function permits continuation. Darkness alone is not a fault. Fog triggers this rule when it compromises required capability.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* A demonstrated backup preserving the function permits continuation. Darkness alone is not a fault. Fog triggers this rule when it compromises required capability. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Abort is based on capability, not individual component failure."; }

elements.body: Following a safety abort, the vessel shall autonomously initiate recovery toward a suitable shore-accessible retrieval location.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Following a safety abort, the vessel shall autonomously initiate recovery toward a suitable shore-accessible retrieval location. */

elements.body: Do not wait for operator intervention or communications. Select a viable route based on remaining capabilities. Intentional grounding at a suitable accessible shore is permitted.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Do not wait for operator intervention or communications. Select a viable route based on remaining capabilities. Intentional grounding at a suitable accessible shore is permitted. */

metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Owner-selected recovery policy; residual risk of movement after traffic-sensing failure requires explicit analysis and review, not assumed acceptance."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall attempt immediate transmission of an abort alert when an abort is declared.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall attempt immediate transmission of an abort alert when an abort is declared. */

elements.body: Queue the alert while communications are unavailable and transmit when contact returns.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Queue the alert while communications are unavailable and transmit when contact returns. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Operator awareness supports shore retrieval without being a prerequisite for recovery."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall support recovery without abandonment of the vessel or its major components in the waterway.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall support recovery without abandonment of the vessel or its major components in the waterway. */

elements.body: Apply flotation, retention and post-capsize recovery obligations C-016 through C-018.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Apply flotation, retention and post-capsize recovery obligations C-016 through C-018. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Owner intent: no littering. This is a recoverability obligation, not a guarantee against every conceivable casualty."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall remain afloat following capsize or hull flooding.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall remain afloat following capsize or hull flooding. */

elements.body: Demonstrate in the declared casualty qualification conditions for the interval needed to execute shore recovery.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Demonstrate in the declared casualty qualification conditions for the interval needed to execute shore recovery. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Derived from recoverability; casualty definition and exposure allocations require SRR review."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall retain its rig, ballast and battery following capsize or hull flooding.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall retain its rig, ballast and battery following capsize or hull flooding. */

elements.body: Use the same casualty qualification conditions as C-016.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Use the same casualty qualification conditions as C-016. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Retained major components prevent debris and support retrieval."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall demonstrate autonomous travel to a suitable shore retrieval location following capsize without communications.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall demonstrate autonomous travel to a suitable shore retrieval location following capsize without communications. */

elements.body: Self-righting is not prescribed; inverted recovery is permitted. Auxiliary propulsion ends qualification. Demonstrate against declared course recovery conditions.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Self-righting is not prescribed; inverted recovery is permitted. Auxiliary propulsion ends qualification. Demonstrate against declared course recovery conditions. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Limp recovery is the required outcome; hull architecture remains open."; }

elements.body: A qualifying attempt shall remain afloat and unattached throughout the scored passage.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* A qualifying attempt shall remain afloat and unattached throughout the scored passage. */

elements.body: Grounding, anchoring, attaching to shore or entering designated refuge ends qualification. Safe waiting under sail is permitted and counts toward elapsed exposure.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Grounding, anchoring, attaching to shore or entering designated refuge ends qualification. Safe waiting under sail is permitted and counts toward elapsed exposure. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Refuge does not preserve partial qualifying progress."; }

elements.body: Loss of communications alone shall not terminate an otherwise safe qualifying attempt.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Loss of communications alone shall not terminate an otherwise safe qualifying attempt. */

elements.body: Continue navigation and retain telemetry onboard; replay retained data after reconnection.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Continue navigation and retain telemetry onboard; replay retained data after reconnection. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Onboard safety and recovery do not depend on contact."; }

elements.body: Launch authorization shall require a forecast window assessed to support the complete round trip with waiting and recovery margins.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Launch authorization shall require a forecast window assessed to support the complete round trip with waiting and recovery margins. */

elements.body: Use the declared mission configuration and forecast-conditioned scenarios. No fixed completion deadline applies.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Use the declared mission configuration and forecast-conditioned scenarios. No fixed completion deadline applies. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Whole-mission assessment replaces an arbitrary sailing-speed floor."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall permit continued qualification during weather-service outage only while the last forecast remains applicable and required safety capabilities remain available.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall permit continued qualification during weather-service outage only while the last forecast remains applicable and required safety capabilities remain available. */

elements.body: Forecast applicability must cover remaining passage and recovery options; assess against observations.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Forecast applicability must cover remaining passage and recovery options; assess against observations. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Loss of data access alone is not an abort trigger."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall protect sufficient energy to reach a suitable shore retrieval location from its current course position.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall protect sufficient energy to reach a suitable shore retrieval location from its current course position. */

elements.body: Account for adverse current, essential onboard loads and uncertainty along the recovery route. No fixed motor-runtime reserve is substituted for route analysis.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Account for adverse current, essential onboard loads and uncertainty along the recovery route. No fixed motor-runtime reserve is substituted for route analysis. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Reserve follows the course and available recovery destinations."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall initiate autonomous recovery before further mission continuation would compromise the course-dependent recovery reserve.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall initiate autonomous recovery before further mission continuation would compromise the course-dependent recovery reserve. */

elements.body: Include the decision and maneuver margin needed to enter recovery.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Include the decision and maneuver margin needed to enter recovery. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Protecting reserve requires timely action, not only energy monitoring."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall support qualifying operation in darkness.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall support qualifying operation in darkness. */

elements.body: Required navigation, traffic safety and observation functions remain applicable. Nightfall alone does not require refuge.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Required navigation, traffic safety and observation functions remain applicable. Nightfall alone does not require refuge. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Passage duration is uncertain and may include overnight sailing."; }

elements.body: An aborted attempt shall remain disqualified until a new attempt begins at the departure gate.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* An aborted attempt shall remain disqualified until a new attempt begins at the departure gate. */

elements.body: No autonomous resumption from refuge. Operator-commanded relocation is permitted outside qualification.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* No autonomous resumption from refuge. Operator-commanded relocation is permitted outside qualification. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Recovery cannot silently resume a partial challenge."; }

elements.body: The vessel shall present conspicuous recovery indications during autonomous shore recovery.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The vessel shall present conspicuous recovery indications during autonomous shore recovery. */

elements.body: Allocate indications consistently with applicable navigation signals; no light or sound configuration is prescribed here.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Allocate indications consistently with applicable navigation signals; no light or sound configuration is prescribed here. */
metadata rationale : ModelingMetadata::Rationale { text = "Prompt recovery and operator alerts do not replace visibility to other users."; }

elements.body: Entrants are encouraged to choose routes and operating windows that reduce encounters with other waterway users. This is nonbinding guidance, not an entry or adjudication criterion. Another vessel changing course or speed is not by itself a breach. Navigation-rule compliance, applicable nonimpediment duties and collision avoidance remain governed by C-007 and C-009.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment trafficCourtesyGuidance /* Entrants are encouraged to choose routes and operating windows that reduce encounters with other waterway users. This is nonbinding guidance, not an entry or adjudication criterion. Another vessel changing course or speed is not by itself a breach. Navigation-rule compliance, applicable nonimpediment duties and collision avoidance remain governed by C-007 and C-009.*/

elements.body: Before entry approval, the entrant shall submit a configuration-specific navigation-rule applicability assessment.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Before entry approval, the entrant shall submit a configuration-specific navigation-rule applicability assessment. */

elements.body: Before entry approval, the entrant shall submit a rule-applicability assessment for the identified vessel, propulsion modes, course and operating conditions. Identify the governing provisions and current local restrictions, required lights/shapes/sound signals, applicable exceptions and supporting authority.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Before entry approval, the entrant shall submit a rule-applicability assessment for the identified vessel, propulsion modes, course and operating conditions. Identify the governing provisions and current local restrictions, required lights/shapes/sound signals, applicable exceptions and supporting authority. */
dependency navigationRuleApplicabilityBasis from navigationRuleApplicability to navigationRules;

elements.body: The organizer shall record and maintain the reviewed rule and notice baseline for the attempt.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The organizer shall record and maintain the reviewed rule and notice baseline for the attempt. */

elements.body: The organizer shall record the reviewed rule and notice baseline; later effective changes shall be reviewed before launch.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* The organizer shall record the reviewed rule and notice baseline; later effective changes shall be reviewed before launch. */
dependency navigationRuleBaselineBasis from navigationRuleBaseline to navigationRules;

elements.body: The organizer shall approve entry only when the configuration-specific navigation evidence satisfies the entry-evidence conditions.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The organizer shall approve entry only when the configuration-specific navigation evidence satisfies the entry-evidence conditions. */

elements.body: Entry approval shall require organizer acceptance of configuration-specific evidence covering relevant sailing, overtaking, crossing and constrained-water encounters, uncertain classification, restricted visibility, degraded sensing and safety intervention. Record assumptions, observation and maneuver limits, pass/fail criteria, physical demonstrations, simulation coverage and remaining exclusions. Unsupported conditions shall be excluded from admission; unresolved capability within admitted conditions prevents entry approval. Entrants shall justify detection distances, margins and maneuver capability. Passing a limited software rule subset does not establish compliance with C-007.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Entry approval shall require organizer acceptance of configuration-specific evidence covering relevant sailing, overtaking, crossing and constrained-water encounters, uncertain classification, restricted visibility, degraded sensing and safety intervention. Record assumptions, observation and maneuver limits, pass/fail criteria, physical demonstrations, simulation coverage and remaining exclusions. Unsupported conditions shall be excluded from admission; unresolved capability within admitted conditions prevents entry approval. Entrants shall justify detection distances, margins and maneuver capability. Passing a limited software rule subset does not establish compliance with C-007. */
dependency navigationEntryEvidenceBasis from navigationEntryEvidence to navigationRules;

elements.body: The operator shall intervene when necessary if autonomous safety action is insufficient and intervention is available.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The operator shall intervene when necessary if autonomous safety action is insufficient and intervention is available. */

elements.body: Safety action shall not be delayed to preserve qualification. Operator intervention or motor propulsion ends qualification under C-003/C-004 even when it prevents a violation.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* Safety action shall not be delayed to preserve qualification. Operator intervention or motor propulsion ends qualification under C-003/C-004 even when it prevents a violation. */
dependency operatorSafetyInterventionBasis from operatorSafetyIntervention to navigationRules;

elements.body: The organizer shall record the attempt qualification decision and its supporting reason against the navigation adjudication conditions.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* The organizer shall record the attempt qualification decision and its supporting reason against the navigation adjudication conditions. */

elements.body: A collision, established navigation-rule breach or unsafe conduct requiring safety intervention disqualifies the attempt. Safety action shall not be delayed to preserve qualification, and the operator shall intervene when necessary if autonomous action is insufficient and intervention is available. Operator intervention or motor propulsion ends qualification under C-003/C-004 even when it prevents a violation. A compliant autonomous avoidance maneuver does not by itself end qualification. The organizer shall adjudicate using retained observations, commands, motion history and independent evidence where available, with a recorded reason. Insufficient evidence leaves qualification unconfirmed; absence of collision alone is not proof of compliance. Entry approval does not waive ongoing obligations.
elements.sysx:sourceText: comment conditions /* A collision, established navigation-rule breach or unsafe conduct requiring safety intervention disqualifies the attempt. Safety action shall not be delayed to preserve qualification, and the operator shall intervene when necessary if autonomous action is insufficient and intervention is available. Operator intervention or motor propulsion ends qualification under C-003/C-004 even when it prevents a violation. A compliant autonomous avoidance maneuver does not by itself end qualification. The organizer shall adjudicate using retained observations, commands, motion history and independent evidence where available, with a recorded reason. Insufficient evidence leaves qualification unconfirmed; absence of collision alone is not proof of compliance. Entry approval does not waive ongoing obligations. */
dependency navigationAdjudicationBasis from navigationAdjudication to navigationRules;

elements.body: Planned qualification cases, not completed evidence. Virtual regression checks and physical demonstrations are separate evidence streams.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Planned qualification cases, not completed evidence. Virtual regression checks and physical demonstrations are separate evidence streams. */

elements.body: Inspect and measure the maximum fore-and-aft extent through all normal rig, steering and equipment configurations. Apply the executable lengthLimit constraint with recorded measurement uncertainty; confirm no unmeasured projection extends beyond the reported envelope.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Inspect and measure the maximum fore-and-aft extent through all normal rig, steering and equipment configurations. Apply the executable lengthLimit constraint with recorded measurement uncertainty; confirm no unmeasured projection extends beyond the reported envelope. */

elements.body: Inject loss of required safety functions, including visibility-driven loss and common-cause faults. Confirm qualification terminates when the function is unavailable; demonstrate continued qualification only when an accepted backup maintains that function.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Inject loss of required safety functions, including visibility-driven loss and common-cause faults. Confirm qualification terminates when the function is unavailable; demonstrate continued qualification only when an accepted backup maintains that function. */

elements.body: From declared course locations and casualty states, remove communications and trigger safety abort. Record recovery initiation, chosen accessible destination, transit and final approach. Assess impaired-sensing collision exposure and consequences independently; a successful transit alone does not accept that residual risk.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* From declared course locations and casualty states, remove communications and trigger safety abort. Record recovery initiation, chosen accessible destination, transit and final approach. Assess impaired-sensing collision exposure and consequences independently; a successful transit alone does not accept that residual risk. */

elements.body: Trigger abort with available and unavailable links. Observe immediate transmission attempts with a link, durable queueing without a link and delivery after reconnection. Timing implementation tolerance must be declared before qualification.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Trigger abort with available and unavailable links. Observe immediate transmission attempts with a link, durable queueing without a link and delivery after reconnection. Timing implementation tolerance must be declared before qualification. */

elements.body: Review and demonstrate the linked flotation, major-component retention and capsize recovery cases using the same casualty configuration. Account for every major component at retrieval.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Review and demonstrate the linked flotation, major-component retention and capsize recovery cases using the same casualty configuration. Account for every major component at retrieval. */

elements.body: Execute the approved flooding and capsize exposure cases with maximum mission load. Observe flotation throughout the course-derived recovery duration. A short static float test cannot substantiate a longer recovery exposure.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Execute the approved flooding and capsize exposure cases with maximum mission load. Observe flotation throughout the course-derived recovery duration. A short static float test cannot substantiate a longer recovery exposure. */

elements.body: Inspect rig, ballast and battery retention before and after the same flooding and capsize cases used for flotation. Record attachments and any released debris.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Inspect rig, ballast and battery retention before and after the same flooding and capsize cases used for flotation. Record attachments and any released debris. */

elements.body: Release the vessel in the declared capsize orientations with communications disabled and execute shore recovery under the approved current, wind and wave profile. Observe arrival at a retrievable location; remaining inverted is allowed. Motor use must disqualify the attempt.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Release the vessel in the declared capsize orientations with communications disabled and execute shore recovery under the approved current, wind and wave profile. Observe arrival at a retrievable location; remaining inverted is allowed. Motor use must disqualify the attempt. */

elements.body: Review timestamped passage records and inject grounding, anchoring, shore attachment and refuge entry. Each ends qualification; safe afloat waiting does not. Missing evidence prevents an affirmative qualification verdict.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Review timestamped passage records and inject grounding, anchoring, shore attachment and refuge entry. Each ends qualification; safe afloat waiting does not. Missing evidence prevents an affirmative qualification verdict. */

elements.body: Interrupt communications during healthy passage and verify continued autonomous operation, retained observations and backlog delivery. Separately inject a safety failure during the outage to ensure loss of contact does not inhibit recovery.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Interrupt communications during healthy passage and verify continued autonomous operation, retained observations and backlog delivery. Separately inject a safety failure during the outage to ensure loss of contact does not inhibit recovery. */

elements.body: Exercise forecast-conditioned launch scenarios covering full passage, waiting and recovery exposure. Reject missing or insufficient forecast coverage. Evaluate the frozen Monte Carlo ensemble and explicit edge cases without treating sample completion fraction as calibrated real-world probability.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Exercise forecast-conditioned launch scenarios covering full passage, waiting and recovery exposure. Reject missing or insufficient forecast coverage. Evaluate the frozen Monte Carlo ensemble and explicit edge cases without treating sample completion fraction as calibrated real-world probability. */

elements.body: Interrupt weather access with applicable and expired forecasts; independently vary onboard safety capability. Confirm continuation requires both applicable forecast information and preserved safety capability.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Interrupt weather access with applicable and expired forecasts; independently vary onboard safety capability. Confirm continuation requires both applicable forecast information and preserved safety capability. */

elements.body: Evaluate route-dependent reserve along the course using installed load evidence, adverse currents, route feasibility and uncertainty. An inaccessible shore, infeasible route or missing input cannot establish a protected reserve.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Evaluate route-dependent reserve along the course using installed load evidence, adverse currents, route feasibility and uncertainty. An inaccessible shore, infeasible route or missing input cannot establish a protected reserve. */

elements.body: Inject declining energy and increasing recovery demand along the route. Confirm recovery begins with sufficient reserve for the decision delay, transition and transit rather than only after reserve exhaustion.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Inject declining energy and increasing recovery demand along the route. Confirm recovery begins with sufficient reserve for the decision delay, transition and transit rather than only after reserve exhaustion. */

elements.body: Exercise the declared navigation, traffic, communications and recovery scenarios in darkness. Confirm nightfall alone does not terminate qualification. Simulation cannot close optical sensing or navigation-light physical evidence.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Exercise the declared navigation, traffic, communications and recovery scenarios in darkness. Confirm nightfall alone does not terminate qualification. Simulation cannot close optical sensing or navigation-light physical evidence. */

elements.body: After abort, test reboot, contact restoration, refuge departure and operator relocation. Qualification remains ended until the new attempt departure-gate condition is met; partial progress is not carried forward.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* After abort, test reboot, contact restoration, refuge departure and operator relocation. Qualification remains ended until the new attempt departure-gate condition is met; partial progress is not carried forward. */

elements.body: Inspect and test recovery indications against the deployment-specific navigation-signal matrix in the approved visibility conditions, including the casualty states for which recovery is claimed.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Inspect and test recovery indications against the deployment-specific navigation-signal matrix in the approved visibility conditions, including the casualty states for which recovery is claimed. */

elements.body: Exercise BlueDogLocationTraffic windsurfCrossing, wingfoilTurn, kiteSweep, fallenRider and groupEncounter across both tacks, overtaking, unknown tack, glare, waves and darkness. Independently record rider/equipment extent, timing, swept-volume clearance and navigation obligations. Include timely, delayed and absent rider avoidance, falls, track swaps and no feasible sailing response. Scripted planar targets or cooperative passes cannot close these cases.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Exercise BlueDogLocationTraffic windsurfCrossing, wingfoilTurn, kiteSweep, fallenRider and groupEncounter across both tacks, overtaking, unknown tack, glare, waves and darkness. Independently record rider/equipment extent, timing, swept-volume clearance and navigation obligations. Include timely, delayed and absent rider avoidance, falls, track swaps and no feasible sailing response. Scripted planar targets or cooperative passes cannot close these cases.*/

elements.body: Exercise BlueDogLocationTraffic windowOverrun and WindowAssessment for surveyed sectors and background reaches on both legs, waiting and recovery. Reject missing traffic evidence, unsupported wind/daylight conditions, incomplete coverage and intervals outside reviewed windows. Compare cumulative exposure, energy, sensing and recovery before departure. Sparse heatmaps and zero observed users cannot establish absence. Reassess delays and unexpected traffic; no accepted window yet.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Exercise BlueDogLocationTraffic windowOverrun and WindowAssessment for surveyed sectors and background reaches on both legs, waiting and recovery. Reject missing traffic evidence, unsupported wind/daylight conditions, incomplete coverage and intervals outside reviewed windows. Compare cumulative exposure, energy, sensing and recovery before departure. Sparse heatmaps and zero observed users cannot establish absence. Reassess delays and unexpected traffic; no accepted window yet.*/

elements.body: Planned case; no completed compliance evidence. Review entry applicability, current rule/notice baseline, installed observation and maneuver evidence, controlled demonstrations and simulation limitations against predeclared criteria. Reject unsupported admitted conditions. Replay compliant autonomous avoidance, no-contact rule breach, collision, operator intervention, motor-assisted safety action and insufficient evidence; confirm their distinct qualification outcomes. Record configuration, conditions, reviewer, evidence and rationale. Do not stage hazardous encounters with uninvolved users.
elements.sysx:sourceText: doc /* Planned case; no completed compliance evidence. Review entry applicability, current rule/notice baseline, installed observation and maneuver evidence, controlled demonstrations and simulation limitations against predeclared criteria. Reject unsupported admitted conditions. Replay compliant autonomous avoidance, no-contact rule breach, collision, operator intervention, motor-assisted safety action and insufficient evidence; confirm their distinct qualification outcomes. Record configuration, conditions, reviewer, evidence and rationale. Do not stage hazardous encounters with uninvolved users.*/

elements.body: Review the approved course, configuration and predeclared admission evidence, then independently reconstruct the ordered finite gate crossings and complete attempt history. Exercise skipped/reversed/touched gates, operator updates, motor thrust, grounding and restart. A complete circuit is insufficient when another governing challenge obligation failed or evidence is missing. Safe unassisted righting preserves qualification only with required safety capability; recovery after disqualification cannot transfer partial progress into a new attempt. Accept C-000 only after every applicable C-001, C-003 through C-010 and C-012 through C-027 obligation has its own accepted evidence or justified coverage in the same attempt.

elements.body: Measure acquisition-to-shore delivery under an available link, including current position, operating mode and health. Interrupt and restore the link; inspect durable backlog replay and continued autonomous control. Exercise authenticated emergency abort and manual-control commands with independent observation of the commanded response and persistent disqualification. Passive monitoring must not change mission state. Distinguish an unavailable link from a failed delivery on an available link. The demonstration must cover the installed vessel and shore endpoints; software queue tests alone do not establish communication service.

elements.body: Review the applicable chart, dam and lock exclusions, local restrictions and current notice baseline for the configured course. Independently compare the complete observed vessel envelope and position uncertainty against approved exclusion geometry throughout the attempt. Exercise approach, navigation-loss and no-feasible-maneuver cases in a controlled test or simulation; do not enter prohibited waters to test the response. A route-planner clearance result is supporting analysis, not evidence that actual operation remained outside restrictions.

elements.body:
Working architecture model, 2026-10-09.
Confirmed threshold: Bingen-Stevenson-Bingen round trip.
Repeated operation is a future endurance objective, outside current acceptance.
Qualifying round trips require no operator intervention; live monitoring is required.
Current design driver: one finite GorgeChallenge::transGorgeChallenge round trip.
Goals::hawaiiVoyage is a separate future mission with its own constraints.
Multi-day endurance with energy harvesting remains an earlier intent. SysML v2 learning is a project goal.
Decomposition identifies responsibilities; physical design remains open.
Tool checks are recorded in the modeling guide; design satisfaction links
are maintained separately and do not establish verification.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Working architecture model, 2026-10-09.
     * Confirmed threshold: Bingen-Stevenson-Bingen round trip.
     * Repeated operation is a future endurance objective, outside current acceptance.
     * Qualifying round trips require no operator intervention; live monitoring is required.
     * Current design driver: one finite GorgeChallenge::transGorgeChallenge round trip.
     * Goals::hawaiiVoyage is a separate future mission with its own constraints.
     * Multi-day endurance with energy harvesting remains an earlier intent. SysML v2 learning is a project goal.
     * Decomposition identifies responsibilities; physical design remains open.
     * Tool checks are recorded in the modeling guide; design satisfaction links
     * are maintained separately and do not establish verification.
     */

by the simulator. These actions do not implement a physical autopilot.

assign directive :=
                if eventKind == "operator_intervention" or eventKind == "manual_weather_update" or eventKind == "motor_use" ? "disqualify"
                else if eventKind == "communications_loss" ? "communications_outage"
                else if eventKind == "weather_service_loss" ? "retain_forecast"
                else if eventKind == "wind_sensor_loss" ? "wind_outage"
                else if eventKind == "navigation_loss" ? "navigation_outage"
                else if eventKind == "capsize" or eventKind == "unassisted_righting" ? "assess_capsize"
                else if eventKind == "forecast_invalidated" or eventKind == "sensing_loss" or eventKind == "steering_loss" or eventKind == "power_loss" or eventKind == "safety_capability_loss" or eventKind == "refuge_entry" or eventKind == "grounding" or eventKind == "anchoring" or eventKind == "shore_attachment" ? "abort"
                else if eventKind == "terminal_failure" ? "stop"
                else "unsupported";
assign recoveryPermitted := eventKind == "sensing_loss" or eventKind == "forecast_invalidated" or eventKind == "safety_capability_loss" or eventKind == "capsize";
assign qualificationLostNext := qualificationLost or directive == "disqualify" or directive == "abort";

elements.body:
Explicit observation contract, not a righting dynamics prediction.
Safety must remain available while inverted. Resumption additionally
requires observed unassisted upright recovery and restored control.
Missing safety evidence fails closed; a prior abort cannot be cleared.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Explicit observation contract, not a righting dynamics prediction.
         * Safety must remain available while inverted. Resumption additionally
         * requires observed unassisted upright recovery and restored control.
         * Missing safety evidence fails closed; a prior abort cannot be cleared. */

assign directive := if abortLatched or qualificationLost or not requiredSafetyConfirmed ? "abort"
                else if uprightRecoveryObserved and not currentlyCapsized ? "invalid_observation"
                else if uprightRecoveryObserved ? "resume"
                else "await_righting";
assign qualificationLostNext := qualificationLost or abortLatched or not requiredSafetyConfirmed;

elements.body:
A nominal upright cycle assumes valid observations supplied by its caller.
Inversion or invalid primary navigation requires explicit confirmation of
retained safety capability. Qualification and safety abort are distinct
persistent states: intervention ends qualification even without a casualty.
The caller supplies geometry and energy assessments; this action owns the
response permissions. It does not predict righting or verify hardware.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* A nominal upright cycle assumes valid observations supplied by its caller.
         * Inversion or invalid primary navigation requires explicit confirmation of
         * retained safety capability. Qualification and safety abort are distinct
         * persistent states: intervention ends qualification even without a casualty.
         * The caller supplies geometry and energy assessments; this action owns the
         * response permissions. It does not predict righting or verify hardware. */
assign abortLatchedNext := abortLatched or abortRequested or reserveThreatened or not requiredSafetyConfirmed;
assign sailingPermitted := windValid and navigationValid and not capsized and not qualificationLostNext;
assign gateScoringPermitted := navigationValid and not capsized and not qualificationLostNext;

assign mode := if abortLatchedNext ? "abort_recovery"
                else if qualificationLostNext ? "disqualified"
                else if capsized ? "capsized_drift"
                else if not navigationValid ? "navigation_degraded"
                else if not windValid ? "degraded_drift"
                else if trafficConflict ? "traffic_avoidance"
                else "sailing";

assign alert := if not abortLatchedNext or abortLatched ? "none"
                else if communicationsAvailable ? "attempt" else "queue";
assign permitted := ordinaryPermission or (independentPath and (eventKind == "steering_loss" or eventKind == "power_loss"));

elements.body: C-000 defines the governing finite challenge obligations. Course review, unassisted sail-only operation, safety capability, recovery reserve and the persistent attempt state apply throughout. Safe unassisted righting may preserve qualification; motor propulsion, external intervention or required safety-capability loss ends it.

Survival requires flotation, attached rig/ballast, dry electronics and retained mission state; course progress is not required. Loss of required safety capability invokes C-012 even when the structure survives.

elements.body: Qualify the complete installation, including sensor, alignment, vessel-frame transformation and communication interface. elements.body: The tail-controlled wing uses aerodynamic control of the main wing's incidence. The actuator moves a small tail control surface rather than directly driving the entire loaded wing. Saildrone describes that wing/tail/tab arrangement in its [design history](https://www.saildrone.com/eu-en/news/how-saildrone-wing-was-born). That supports investigating low trim energy; it does not supply a Blue Dog actuator power value or prove that a jammed actuator will feather safely.

That supports investigating low trim energy; it does not supply a Blue Dog actuator power value or prove that a jammed actuator will feather safely. */

elements.body: The [Silva et al. wingsail design paper](https://recipp.ipp.pt/bitstream/10400.22/15346/1/CAPL_LSA_MBM_2019.pdf) describes the corresponding moment balance and highlights the tail/counterweight trade: balancing a free wing can add elevated mass and increase its swept envelope. This motivates retaining the tail-controlled candidate, while bearing friction, tail authority, tab faults, submerged loads and counterweight mass must remain explicit design problems.

elements.body: The closest primary precedent found is Miller, Judge, Sewell and Williamson's [*An Alternative Wing Sail Concept for Small Autonomous Sailing Craft*](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/323361410_An_Alternative_Wing_Sail_Concept_for_Small_Autonomous_Sailing_Craft), published in *Robotic Sailing 2017* (2018), DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-72739-4_1. Its abstract reports wind-tunnel and on-water evaluation of a square-sail-derived wing on the 1.2 m MaxiMOOP, with condition-dependent performance and practical advantages over its soft-sail comparator. The [MaxiMOOP platform page](https://www.sailbot.org/maximoop/) associates the asymmetric-wing test platform with the U.S. Naval Academy. This is the closest match located, not a confirmed NPS-authored paper. The accessible abstract supports concept precedent; the full numerical results have not been inspected or imported.

elements.body: The [official PC13 entry](https://www.microtransat.org/content.php?p=2026_oshen_cstar) describes a single DynaRig wingsail driven by a motor inside the hull, a 1.299 m hull, 56 kg displacement, 52.5 W solar and a 100 Ah battery. Its auxiliary thruster was unused during the challenge. Neither the airfoil section nor the gearbox's backdrivability is established by that description. PC13 strengthens the case for direct mast actuation; it does not verify our fixed-camber geometry or energy budget.

elements.body: The [organizer announced autonomous east-to-west completion on 13 September 2026](https://microtransat.org/content.php?p=news%2F2026-09-13-oshen), with the result provisional pending jury review in that announcement. This is relevant integrated endurance evidence, not a statistical reliability estimate. The [Oshen/MBARI evaluation of other C-Star configurations](https://oceansynchro.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/OshenC-Star_ReportFinal-1.pdf) identified light-wind/current navigation limitations and evaluated auxiliary propulsion. An ocean crossing therefore does not establish sail-only upstream Gorge progress. PC13's compact length also does not establish compliance with our one-person handling allocations.

elements.body: The concern is maintenance-free exposure. North Sails identifies [flogging, flutter and flex fatigue](https://www.northsails.com/en-us/blogs/north-sails-blog/four-fs-sail-fatigue-flex-fiber-compression-flogging-flutter), and recommends [chafe protection, UV protection and inspection](https://www.northsails.com/en-uk/blogs/north-sails-blog/sail-care-maintenance-tips-diy). For the finite Gorge mission, fabric/line wear and autonomous sail handling are comparison criteria alongside rigid-wing bearing, drive and skin risks. The soft sail remains an equal development contender; persistent ocean service is a separate future exposure. A furling or self-locking winch may address some risks, but introduces its own mechanisms and failure cases.

The soft sail remains an equal development contender; persistent ocean service is a separate future exposure. A furling or self-locking winch may address some risks, but introduces its own mechanisms and failure cases. */
dependency sail8Basis from BlueDogDesignDecisions::sizingBaseline to sail8;

elements.body: Rigid construction also has real durability limits. Saildrone reports that tall wings were damaged during Southern Ocean attempts; its lower-aspect replacement improved survival while sacrificing upwind capability. That is directly relevant to a mission requiring upstream windward progress. See [Saildrone's account of the Antarctic circumnavigation](https://www.saildrone.com/eu-en/news/unmanned-vehicle-completes-antarctica-circumnavigation). Avoiding sailcloth does not establish wave-impact survival.

elements.body: If an installation is an aid to maritime navigation, 33 CFR 66.01-1 requires permission to establish it. That provision neither declares every scientific buoy an aid nor supplies a blanket exemption for small research platforms. Whether it applies to a proposed observation installation must be resolved for that installation. elements.body:
Freeze actual article/software/storage/clock configuration and procedure.
Independently observe command receipt, authority/expiry assessment,
durable disqualification acknowledgment and physical motor enable.
Inject stale/future/reordered/replayed commands, expired permissions,
missing acknowledgments, primary loss and reset between each boundary.
Confirm no thrust while qualification is qualifying or unknown and no
commanded enable before durable disqualification. Establish legitimate
onboard recovery authorization separately from authenticated operator
authorization. Measure the governed restart/response deadlines using
appropriate instrumentation; synthetic gate checks do not close them.
Retain failures, input loss and power-cut corruption, not only clean runs.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Freeze actual article/software/storage/clock configuration and procedure.
         * Independently observe command receipt, authority/expiry assessment,
         * durable disqualification acknowledgment and physical motor enable.
         * Inject stale/future/reordered/replayed commands, expired permissions,
         * missing acknowledgments, primary loss and reset between each boundary.
         * Confirm no thrust while qualification is qualifying or unknown and no
         * commanded enable before durable disqualification. Establish legitimate
         * onboard recovery authorization separately from authenticated operator
         * authorization. Measure the governed restart/response deadlines using
         * appropriate instrumentation; synthetic gate checks do not close them.
         * Retain failures, input loss and power-cut corruption, not only clean runs. */

elements.body:
Combined product verification and stakeholder-use validation.
Use the identified actual operator, candidate installation, handling
aids and surveyed recovery destination. Declare conditions, access,
retrieval exposure, acceptance criteria and recovery arrangements before
the trial. Observe autonomous approach separately from shore capture,
retention and one-person pickup. Measure applicable handling outcomes;
assess whether the intended user can complete the whole recovery task.
Record failures, assistance, unsafe access and incomplete retrieval.
A simulated approach, propulsion command or cooperative fixture alone
cannot establish intended-use recovery or physical qualification.
elements.sysx:sourceText:
doc /* Combined product verification and stakeholder-use validation.
         * Use the identified actual operator, candidate installation, handling

         * retrieval exposure, acceptance criteria and recovery arrangements before
         * the trial. Observe autonomous approach separately from shore capture,
         * retention and one-person pickup. Measure applicable handling outcomes;
         * assess whether the intended user can complete the whole recovery task.
         * Record failures, assistance, unsafe access and incomplete retrieval.
         * A simulated approach, propulsion command or cooperative fixture alone
         * cannot establish intended-use recovery or physical qualification. */
dependency recoveryConfiguration from recoveryUseTrial to HumanRecoveryUseValidation;
dependency intendedRecoveryUse from HumanRecoveryUseValidation to BlueDogUseCases::recover;

doc /*
         *  Assess capsize recovery for the declared installed configuration and casualty profile. Use N-051/N-052 only for the selected passive-righting strategy; retain independent C-018 post-capsize shore recovery. Establish required safety capability, restrictions and qualification persistence during inversion and after recovery. A righting result alone cannot close N-003. */

elements.body: For the declared loaded configuration and reproducible route/weather ensemble, establish whole-route sailing capability from accepted sailing, maneuver, energy and recovery evidence. Retain failed routes and holds in exposure accounting. Independently assess preservation of mission-critical functions across the same exposure, including interacting faults and recoveries. Review Q-101 through Q-103 and L-103/L-104 evidence; the provisional L-101/L-102 study target cannot substitute for functional coverage or safety disposition. Numerical screens, a successful isolated course and uncalibrated simulation completion fractions do not close the installed-vessel capability claim.

Review Q-101 through Q-103 and L-103/L-104 evidence; the provisional L-101/L-102 study target cannot substitute for functional coverage or safety disposition. Numerical screens, a successful isolated course and uncalibrated simulation completion fractions do not close the installed-vessel capability claim. */

elements.body: Measure coincident installed withdrawal demand for each admitted mode and transition, including sensing, signaling, actuation and recovery. Disable harvesting and exercise conservative battery temperature, state of charge, end-of-service capacity, conversion losses and declared uncertainty. Compare each demand with demonstrated supply capability using E-203, and observe voltage-dependent loss of required function and protective trips. A component nameplate or summed nominal power does not establish installed peak delivery.

A component nameplate or summed nominal power does not establish installed peak delivery. */
